notes.title: Myth of Empires: Xizhou Civilization DLC is Now Live – S4 Season Begins!
notes.content:
Developed by Angela Game and published by Imperium Interactive Entertainment, the cold weapon warfare sandbox MMO Myth of Empires has officially launched the Xizhou Civilization DLC on March 21 at 02:00 UTC.
On the same day at 14:00 UTC, multiple new County Servers will open under New Era and Jade Era, including the highly anticipated S4 Global Season Server. Powerful factions will once again clash in intense battles, vying for the $10,000 cash prize!


Within two weeks of the Xizhou Civilization DLC launch, players can enjoy a 10% discount on the Xizhou Civilization Pack. Additionally, from March 20 at 17:00 UTC to April 3 at 17:00 UTC, there will be discounts on several items: the Myth of Empires base game and Dongzhou Map will be 65% off, the Hellenic Civilization Pack will be 40% off, and both the Musical Instruments Pack and the Royal Carriages Pack will be 50% off. 

Myth of Empires – Xizhou Civilization Pack：https://store.steampowered.com/app/3502710/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/32c787bae5822d00f8466f6b8228aa180db69872.jpg[/img]

[h3]Xizhou Civilization DLC Highlights[/h3]
In the new Xizhou map, the desert and oasis coexist, creating a unique ecological environment that nurtures creatures such as camels and ostriches. Players can tame and breed these animals, making them valuable allies in their adventures. Hidden within the map are secrets to immortality and rare resources, which will help players craft unique armor and weapons. These treasures have attracted the attention of various factions, leading to a land filled with undercurrents, danger, and intrigue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/626068252abe2194ad3251cba065015430778649.jpg[/img]

The Xizhou Civilization Pack includes a set of distinctive buildings that reflect the unique architectural style of the Xizhou civilization, allowing players to create homes full of exotic charm. Additionally, it unlocks the Imperial Fall device, which integrates functions such as power generation, mining, teleportation, storage, and manufacturing, enabling seamless automation in production. Furthermore, five powerful vehicles and devices—Aerial Fortress, Desert Ship, Navigator, Mechanized Woodcutter, and Mechanized Horse—will each serve their purpose, offering new options for combat, resource gathering, and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/6d66ec1b67b92fb1b40af6233014556b59f90292.jpg[/img]

The Xizhou map is home to numerous hidden cave dungeons, where strange and deadly bosses such as the Mongolian Sandworm, Moss Giant, and XiXi Spider King lie in wait for daring adventurers. In the faction camps, powerful monsters are also imprisoned, offering a unique opportunity for brave explorers. Their presence serves as both a challenge and a perfect chance to prove one's strength!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/1e94c3745824d36d34d0b1a973c22945f6d13888.jpg[/img]

[h3]Base Game Major Update![/h3]
The excitement goes beyond the Xizhou Civilization DLC, as the base game also receives a major update. New features such as the Profession System, Martial Scroll, Crop Expertise, and Horse Grooming, along with the addition of Construction Bureau buildings and Zipline structures, will provide players with even more diverse and enriching gameplay experiences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/2ce6b09e19fad082ddc57ae076bf7c98a987fb79.jpg[/img]

For the March 21 update, please refer to the official announcement for all the details：https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1371580/view/615409552076048368

[h3]The S4 Season has begun, with a grand prize of 10,000 USD waiting for you to claim![/h3]
The S4 Season will officially begin on March 21 at 14:00 UTC and run until June 23 at 00:00 UTC. Unlike previous seasons, the S4 Season introduces a $10,000 USD cash prize for the top guilds. At the end of the season, the top 10 guild leaders will share this generous prize. We look forward to seeing all heroes join this intense competition for the ultimate top 10 glory!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/e1af6c38aef2dad26e100e6b5ce8d91d577dbc4a.jpg[/img]

[h3]The official shop has launched new items, coming with celebration events![/h3]
To celebrate the release of the Xizhou Civilization DLC, the official shop is offering a limited-time 30% off sale across all items. Additionally, brand-new skins for Lu Bu and Zhang Fei have been unveiled, adding unique charm to your characters. In-game events like Kongming Lantern drops, County Blessings, and Seven-Day Login Rewards will also be available, so don’t miss out!

With the launch of the Xizhou Civilization DLC, Myth of Empires expands its vibrant multi-civilization game world. Players will experience a fresh new map, unique functional buildings, powerful vehicles and devices, thrilling cave dungeons, and a variety of gameplay features. There’s so much more to explore—join this adventure full of challenges and surprises today!

notes.title: Update & Maintenance Notice 3/21/2025
notes.content:
Dear Players,

On March 20, 2025, from 21:00 to March 21, 2025, 02:00 UTC, Myth of Empires will undergo maintenance for the Xizhou Civilization DLC update, with an estimated duration of 5 hours. Please plan your gameplay accordingly to avoid any unnecessary losses. The exact server reopening time will depend on the maintenance progress.
Thank you for your understanding and support.


After this update, the existing territories in the "New Era" world will be designated as [Territory 1], while a brand-new parallel territory, [Territory 2], will be introduced.
Server Launch Plan on March 21, 2025, at 14:00 UTC:
1.Territory 1: New county towns in the Xizhou map will be opened, accessible to players who own the Xizhou Civilization DLC.
2.Territory 2: Additional new county towns will be introduced across multiple maps (Zhongzhou, Dongzhou, and Xizhou). For the first 180 days after launch, Territory 2 and Territory 1 will remain separate, meaning no cross-server access, and guilds, alliances, and trading post data will be completely independent. After 180 days, cross-server connectivity will be enabled.


The server launch plan for Jade Era is as follows：
(1)	Similarly, several "Xizhou Map" servers are planned to be launched. Players who own the Xizhou Civilization DLC will be able to enter these servers.


At the same time, the S4 Seasonal Server will launch as scheduled. The new season will be extended to 3 months, running from March 21, 2025, 14:00 UTC to June 23, 2025, 00:00 UTC.
Compete for dominance against rival forces and claim your share of the $10,000 cash prize!


[h3]Xizhou Civilization DLC Launch Celebration Event [/h3]
Event Duration: March 21, 2025, 14:00 UTC — March 28, 2025, 00:00 UTC


[b]Kongming Lantern Event[/b]
This event is only available on non-seasonal servers.
(1)	During the event, Kongming Lanterns will randomly drop from the sky across the entire map. Players can predict where the lanterns will fall and head to those locations in advance. The lanterns will contain various in-game items.
(2)	There is a chance to obtain a Cloud-piercing Arrow from the Kongming Lantern. When using a bow and arrow to shoot the Cloud-piercing Arrow into the sky, an additional Kongming Lantern will be summoned in the current area.

[b]County Blessing Event[/b]
(1)	Non-seasonal servers: Gathering output +100% (Stone, Plants, Animals), Taming multiplier +100% (Warriors and Mounts)

(2)	Seasonal servers: When crafting Wotou and arrows, there is a 33% chance to receive an additional 100% single-item yield.

[b]7-Day Login Rewards[/b]
Each day, rewards will be sent to each player via in-game mail.


[h3]Update Details[/h3]
[b]New Content in Xizhou Civilization DLC (Available for players who purchase the Xizhou Civilization DLC)[/b]
(1)	New Xizhou Map: This map features exclusive resources essential for crafting DLC-related equipment.
(2)	New Silk Road Atlas Missions: Players can access the Silk Road Atlas via the navigation tab in their inventory while in the Xizhou Map. These missions will guide players to locate and defeat bosses, earning DLC-related mission rewards.
(3)	New Chaos Attribute: The Chaos Attribute is effective only in Silk Road Atlas instances and boss battles. This attribute can be obtained through Xizhou equipment and by completing Silk Road Atlas missions.
(4)	New Xizhou Civilization Recipes: These recipes will be unlocked progressively by completing Silk Road Atlas missions.
(5)	New Imperial Fall Buildings: The Imperial Fall Buildings provide protection against the stamina reduction effects caused by the desert regions.
(6)	New Imperial Fall Animal-Powered Automatic Gate: After placing animal-powered items, the gate will automatically open when guild members approach from the rear.
(7)	New Imperial Fall Universal Workbench: By consuming the corresponding workbench items, players can select and activate recipes from other workstations for crafting.
(8)	New Imperial Fall Transportation Device Recipes: Players can build transportation devices (requiring connection to energy structures) to enable automatic resource transport, which can only be connected to Imperial Fall Buildings.
(9)	New Xizhou Equipment Recipes: Weapons will have basic Chaos Attack attributes, and armor will have basic Chaos Defense attributes (these attributes will be effective in Xizhou instances and boss battles).
(10)	New Rare Firearms: These can be crafted into ranged firearms, supporting both ranged and melee modes, offering enhanced combat versatility.
(11)	New Vehicle – Aerial Fortress: Available for placement once the guild reaches Level 5 (The total limit for Battleships, Desert Ships, and Aerial Fortresses is 10). The vehicle allows for free building construction.
(12)	New Vehicle – Desert Ship: Available for placement once the guild reaches Level 5 (The total limit for Battleships, Desert Ships, and Aerial Fortresses is 10). The vehicle allows for free building construction.
(13)	New Vehicle – Mechanized Horse: Players can customize and record the Mechanized Horse's movement coordinates, enabling automatic travel based on the recorded path. It can also carry 6 Zhuge Mechanical Crossbows for concentrated fire to attack enemies.
(14)	New Vehicle – Mechanized Woodcutter: This is a two-person vehicle, with various resource gathering arms that can be installed on both sides. The vehicle can also equip one of the following: Cart-mounted Ice Container, Cart-mounted Censer, or Cart-mounted Brazier.
(15)	New Vehicle – Navigator: This vehicle can be placed in water. By connecting to a power cage and propeller, it enables movement on water. Connecting a buoyancy increases its weight capacity. The vehicle supports free construction.
(16)	New Beast Lord – Crocodile King: The Crocodile King Relic can be obtained by defeating the Mystic Hunter. Using the token, players can summon and tame the Crocodile King. The Crocodile King can be equipped with the Crocodile King Saddle – Platform.
(17)	New Mounts – Ostrich, Camel, and Bloodstain Steed: These mounts are immune to stamina and speed debuffs in the Xizhou Map. The Bloodstain Steed requires a specific skill to activate its abilities.
(18)	New Guild Option for Warrior Dispatch: The Xizhou Map now has an added guild option for dispatching warriors.
(19)	New Shah Civilization Talent: A new talent for the Shah Civilization has been added.
(20)	New Medicine – Endurance Pill: This dish increases the character's stamina recovery speed for a certain period of time.

[b]New Content for the Base Game[/b]
(1)	New Profession System: The profession system is activated when the character reaches level 40 and achieves a proficiency of 600 in the corresponding profession. Professions include Imperial Guard (Shield), Tiger Step (One-Handed), Berseker Battalion (Two-Handed), Silver Wing Guard (Polearm), and Martial Archery Expert (Bow). By activating the profession and using the corresponding weapon to defeat targets, players can earn profession experience, learn, and equip profession-specific skills.
(2)	New Martial Scroll Function: This feature allows players to upgrade and bless their equipment, enhancing its attributes. Equipment that has been blessed will not drop upon the character's death. The required items for this upgrade can be obtained by defeating bosses in the Silk Road Atlas on the Xizhou Map DLC.
(3)	New Crop Expertise System: When harvesting premium crops, there is a chance to obtain mother plants. Harvesting these premium crops grants experience for the corresponding crop type. The higher the crop expertise level, the better the quality of the mother plant obtained during harvesting. Mother plants come with various attributes and skills. When a selected mother plant is used for planting by the character or a warrior, it provides attribute bonuses based on the skills of the mother plant.
(4)	New Guild Technology – Construction Bureau: By assigning warriors to the Construction Bureau, players can prioritize their work tasks. When copper coins are placed in the bureau, all workstations within the building’s range can be automatically operated by the warriors assigned to them.
(5)	New Recipe – Zipline: Place the zipline poles at both ends on the map. Then, place the zipline in the character's shortcut bar. By interacting with the poles using the zipline, players can travel between the locations efficiently.
(6)	New Horse Grooming Feature: Players can place their horses in the stable and use the grooming function. By consuming horse grooming tools, players can customize the appearance of their horses. These grooming tools can be purchased from the Golden Token Shop.
(7)	New Elite Strategist Skill: By taming NPCs with attributes, players have a chance to obtain warriors with the Elite Strategist skill. The Elite Strategist Skill Book can be obtained by opening the Lost Treasure Box.
(8)	New Recipe – Processing Energy: This item can be placed in a workbench. It increases the work efficiency of the character or warrior while working for a set period.
(9)	New Recipe – Rice Cake: This item increases the Fullness of the character and warrior, and boosts their maximum health for a certain period.
(10)	New Recipe – Life-Prolonging Pill: This item significantly restores the health of the character and warrior.
(11)	New Recipe – Premium Mount EXP Pill: This item increases the experience of mounts and Beast Lords. It can be actively used on mounts and Beast Lords to level them up.
(12)	New Items in the Lost Treasure Box: Treasure Protection Scroll Gift Box, Nine-Reversal Heaven-Repairing Pill Gift Box, Equipment Durability Potion Gift Box, Beast Lord Stamina Potion Gift Box, Hundred Herbs Healing Pill Gift Box, Tactical Rations Gift Box, Ancient Secret Scroll Choice Box, Skill Talisman Gift Box, Heavenly Craft Progression Elixir – Jiuzhou, Heavenly Craft Progression Elixir – Hellas, Heavenly Craft Progression Elixir – Shah, Bag of Divine Strength (30 Days), Advanced Challenge Horn, Heavenly Horse Lure, Glyphs Token, Spirit Awakening Elixir, Blood Oath Talisman, Heavenly Craft Blueprint, High-quality Farmland, Premium Farmland, Elite Strategist Skill Book and more. For specific item descriptions, players can check the " How to get rare items " button in the lower-right corner of the character's inventory.
(13)	New Skins in the Shop: Added Guan Yu, Zhao Yun, Huangzhong, Lu Bu Armor and Weapon skins. Players can now preview and purchase these unique skins in the shop.
(14)	New Building Skin in the Shop: The Sacred Sky Radiance Building Set has been added to the shop, allowing players to preview and purchase this new architectural style.
(15)	New Achievements Related to Professions
(16)	New Tally Order Season 12: The 12th season of the Tally Order event has been added, with the event running from 12:00 AM on April 1, 2025, to 12:00 AM on July 1, 2025 UTC Time. Additionally, new items are now available for exchange in the Store.

[b]Optimization Adjustments[/b]
(1)	Proficiency Calculation Optimization: Proficiency related to combat will now be calculated based on the damage dealt.
(2)	Large Kongming Lantern Adjustment: Small Mangonel (War Elephant) can now be placed on the large Kongming lantern.
(3)	Lost Treasure Box Adjustments: Increased the drop rate of High-Quality Farmland and Premium Farmland.
(4)	Farmland Adjustments: Reduced the natural recovery rate of water and fertilizer.


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
(1)	Fixed the issue where players could not use the Wallet due to a character name being too long.

notes.title: Compete for a Share of $10,000! Myth of Empires S4 Season Rules Revealed!
notes.content:
When the Xizhou Civilization DLC launches on March 21, the flames of battle in Myth of Empires S4 Season will reignite!

All players across the servers can join this ultimate showdown. Be sure to carefully review the detailed S4 Season rules and prepare for war!

This season, we’ve prepared an unprecedented surprise for the victors—[b]a massive $10,000 prize pool![/b] Who will rise above the fierce competition and claim a spot in the top 10? Let’s find out!

notes.title: S4 Season will launch on March 21. New server plan for DLC revealed
notes.content:
On March 21, as the Xizhou Civilization DLC servers go live, the all-new S4 Season of Myth of Empires will also begin, lasting for three months until June 23. All servers will be in PVP mode, with no region-locking.

For this S4 Season, the official team has prepared an amazing surprise—a cash reward pool of up to $10,000! After the season ends, this generous reward will be distributed to the top 10 guild leaders based on the season’s rankings. Just imagine, if your guild manages to rise above the fierce competition and stand at the peak as the ultimate victor, how glorious it would be to claim the reward! Get ready to lead your guild to an all-out sprint for victory!

At the same time, the official team also revealed the server launch plan for the Xizhou Civilization DLC. Let’s take a look together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/25455767eb849855677f1ff83b86235f2f8dddf3.jpg[/img]

[h3]1. Introduction to the Main Rules and Prize Distribution of S4 Season[/h3]
[h3]I. Key Features of the Season Server[/h3]
(1)	Players will receive ample Comprehension Points and Recipe Points at the start. Upon death, equipped armor and items in the shortcut bar will not drop, only durability will be lost.
(2)	The basic resource output, taming speed, breeding speed, honor, and guild activity points will all be further increased, with gradual improvements as the season progresses.
(3)	Skills unlocked during the season won’t require skill books. Combat proficiency will automatically increase with character level, and acquiring honor will be easier. The amount of copper coins from NPC drops and resource collection will also be increased.
(4)	There will be phase-based restrictions. For example, during the early stages of the season, buildings and some siege weapons will have a certain damage reduction, and characters will have a level cap (specific details will be based on the upcoming S4 season settings).
(5)	The damage of shields, ranged weapons for characters, and use of certain mounts have been enhanced. The crossbow and the ballista towers controlled by warriors are no longer guaranteed hits. More practical items can now be purchased with copper coins through guild shops.
(6)	Season points can be exchanged for items in the next season. Players who reach 250,000 season points will receive skin rewards, and the top 10 guild members by points will receive exclusive skin rewards.
(7)	Contribution points earned after the season can also be exchanged for related items in the non-seasonal server. Additionally, after the season ends, players can choose to seal one warrior and one mount to carry over for use in the next season.

[h3]II. Compared to the S3 Season, the S4 Season will bring changes in the following aspects[/h3]
(1)	Crossbow-type equipment: The damage dealt to characters, warriors, and mounts has been reduced, but the damage to buildings and vehicles remains consistent with the official server
(2)	Added an increase in profession skill experience multiplier
(3)	In county, prefecture, and fortress battles, the resurrection cooldown time for large mounts and beast lords has been increased after they are defeated
(4)	Significantly increased the drop rate of newly added bosses in the Xizhou civilization DLC
(5)	The health and breeding speed of ostriches and camels will be significantly increased
(6)	The speed of gaining honor has been significantly increased

notes.title: Myth of Empires - Xizhou Civilization DLC launching on March 21! Pre-orders now
notes.content:
Developed by Angela Games and published by Imperium Interactive Entertainment, the multiplayer war sandbox game Myth of Empires has officially announced that the Xizhou Civilization DLC will launch on March 21. A pre-order trailer has also been released. The Xizhou Civilization Pack is now available for pre-order on Steam, selling for  $14.99 and a limited time 10% discount.

The Xizhou Civilization Pack includes a brand-new Xizhou map, a set of Imperial Fall devices, 4 types of functional vehicles, 9 sets of new armor, 16 unique weapons, 2 fine animal saddles, a set of unique building recipes, a construction bench, new consumable, and 3 types of smelting materials. Additionally, the Xizhou Civilization DLC will introduce a new Shah civilization growth system, where players can unlock different development paths based on their skills, gaining unique civilization bonuses.

Pre-order link：https://store.steampowered.com/app/3502710/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/bf4babd88b5cfbdfcb1f23b738c57dd67e4c3b61.jpg[/img]

Trailer link：https://youtu.be/valL58Tyhr0

[h3]Xizhou Map: A Land of Adventure, Danger and Opportunity[/h3]
The new map centers around deserts and oases, blending various factions and cultural elements to create a unique landscape and ecosystem. This region boasts distinctive cultural characteristics, but it is also a land of chaos, with multiple factions vying for control. The map is filled with hidden cave dungeons, such as lava caves, sandworm caves, and ancient tombs, where strange and deadly bosses lurk, tempting high-level players to take on the challenge. Through the main storyline, players can delve deeper, uncovering the secrets behind the Xizhou Civilization and earning rich rewards meant only for the bravest of adventurers.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/2ef4149b56308ce350adcfc52c9c73ea377355ce.jpg[/img]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/7e51c670d0040b677c9ef1d8bb5a81a8d6a8d5dc.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Era of Civilization: Automated Production + Four New Vehicles[/h3]
The Xizhou Civilization DLC not only introduces the exotic Imperial Fall building recipes but also brings the Imperial Fall automated devices, which integrate power generation, mining, transport, storage, and manufacturing functions. This system fully automates the resource production process, greatly improving efficiency. The four new functional vehicles will also redefine survival and combat strategies. The Desert Ship and Navigator serve as large land and water-based mobile platforms, supporting the placement of buildings, workbenches, weapons, and more. The modular design fully unleashes players' creativity and freedom, making them invaluable multi-functional mobile bases. The Mechanized Woodcutter is the first two-person functional vehicle, featuring high load capacity and exceptional gathering efficiency, offering strong practicality. The Mechanized Horse autonomously transports materials by following a programmed navigation path. When equipped with a Mechanical Crossbow, it can transform into a combat support unit, proving itself to be a versatile and indispensable asset.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/e0d571259697d02fad91eb5448457afbf7ec0bc9.jpg[/img]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/37f2b67a7fa2c41749087542a60fe8624d3e700b.jpg[/img]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/cb7d6d7d42029250ec91f652fb169c74b471cb96.jpg[/img]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/3e6c771ecb14e4c6e09757cc4564eee91579a09c.jpg[/img]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/111adfcfd2dda1a8f4c8a750a8fb6e45fefca981.jpg[/img]

[h3]Instance Gameplay: Challenge Cave Bosses[/h3]
In addition to the numerous ground camps scattered across the map, the Xizhou Civilization DLC introduces more Instance challenges and main quests. Players can explore underground caves filled with lava, sandworms, spiders, mushrooms, and ancient tombs, facing hidden dangers along the way. The ultimate goal is to conquer unique boss battles, such as the Giant Spider and Sandworm Lord, to earn special rewards. These dungeons not only test players' combat skills but also emphasize teamwork and strategic planning.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/31fc380f1c32f885031c4833766a92a47d275728.jpg[/img]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/93f41388eb96de6886788c006549fbb747f6c068.jpg[/img]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/1198ed336bbba5ab2e091a33cac846625c580167.jpg[/img]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/42d2ac720cb4de088c4cd11237c9229fa988c20b.jpg[/img]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/cc99f113da185b0b92f0320614346a113ac7ff4a.jpg[/img]

[h3]Base Game Update: Profession Change System + In-Depth Progression[/h3]
With the release of the Xizhou Civilization DLC, the base game will introduce several exciting new features. Once players reach level 40 and skill level 600, they can undergo profession change, unlocking five new professions, including the Imperial Guard, Berseker Battalion, Martial Archery Expert and more. Each profession comes with unique skills and talents, allowing players to choose their development path based on personal preference. Additionally, harvesting specific crops may yield Mother Plants with distinct skills and weaknesses, which can be cultivated to produce plants with superior attributes, optimizing farm output. Other new features, such as Martial Scripture Scrolls, horse grooming, Construction Bureau building, and zipline buildings, will offer even more customization options and fun gameplay experiences for players.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/e62a05b08d24f7a8a2f2727ec2de13c40adc0733.jpg[/img]

The Xizhou Civilization DLC will officially launch on March 21. Pre-ordering the Xizhou Civilization Pack will grant a 10% discount. Players can now visit the Steam store page for more details and add the game to their wish-list, planning their journey to conquer the Xizhou in advance!

About Myth of Empires
Myth of Empires is a multiplayer sandbox game featuring a high degree of freedom and multiple civilizations. Players will fight to survive and earn their place in a world torn by war, build fortresses, lead armies in massive battles, siege enemy cities, and establish their own empires.

notes.title: Latest Update on Myth of Empires: Profession Changes, Crop Expertise, and More!
notes.content:
We are excited to bring you the latest news on the Persia DLC: [h3]The DLC has been officially titled Xizhou Civilization DLC.[/h3] Next week, we will reveal the release date and other important details. Stay tuned!

After the previous nine developer logs, you’re likely already familiar with the content of the Xizhou Civilization DLC. But the excitement doesn’t stop there. Along with the release of the Xizhou Civilization DLC, Myth of Empires will also introduce a series of new features and gameplay elements, such as profession changes, crop expertise, Martial Scripture Scrolls, construction bureau buildings, and zipline buildings. These additions will bring an even richer and more diverse gaming experience.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/e2fb9c00a1829f482878c26114d327424557ea85.jpg[/img]

[h2]Next, let’s get an exclusive sneak peek at the new content coming with this developer log:[/h2]

[h3]1.	Profession Change[/h3]
Five new professions will be available: Imperial Guard, Tiger Step, Berseker Battalion, Silver Wing Guard, and Martial Archery Expert.
a.	Once the player's character reaches level 40 and a specific skill proficiency of 600, they can learn a new profession. Additionally, after meeting the required conditions, players can switch to and learn other professions in the profession change interface.
b.	Professions can level up: While in an active state, using the corresponding weapon and equipment for a profession, players can earn experience points by defeating enemies.
c.	Each profession skill has specific weapon and equipment requirements, and only by using the corresponding weapon for that profession can players unleash profession skills and trigger profession talents.
d.	The number of equip-able profession skills and talents is influenced by the profession level. Each profession can equip up to 2 profession skills and 4 profession talents at the same time.

[h3]2.	Crops Expertise[/h3]
A brand-new Crop Expertise system is planned to be introduced for six crop types: Wheat, Barley, Flax, Notoginseng, Rice, and Soybean.
a.	When harvesting these six types of crops, there is a chance to obtain a corresponding Mother Plant. Additionally, harvesting these crops will also increase the corresponding Expertise Level for each crop.
b.	Expertise Level affects: the total fertilizer discount value for dropping mother plants, the number of uses, and the entry skills (which vary in quality).
c.	Mother plants have entry skills, but there are differences between them. By deploying the mother plant for sowing (this also applies when warriors plant crops), you can harvest crops that have the effect of the mother plant’s skills (excluding low-quality crops).
d.	Mother plants can be cultivated: By breeding two different mother plants, you can create a new mother plant with different levels, entry skills, and weaknesses.

[h3]3.	Martial Scripture Scrolls[/h3]
There are two types: Common Secret Scroll and Ancient Secret Scroll. The basic functions are described as follows:
a.	Modification: For scrolls that have already been obtained, you can consume specific materials to randomly grant the scroll new attributes. Each modification will increase the modification proficiency, and reaching a certain proficiency level will upgrade the modification level.
b.	Blessing: By consuming a scroll, its attributes can be attached to equipment. Additionally, depending on the modification level, when using equipment that has been blessed, the character will gain extra bonuses, in addition to the attributes granted by the scroll.
c.	Consume: Using equipment that has been blessed with an Ancient Scroll, you can alter its smithing attributes and maximum durability through the consume process.
d.	Reshape: Using equipment that has been blessed with an Ancient Scroll, you can change its level, appearance, and attack method through the Reshape process.

[h3]4.	Construction Bureau Building[/h3]
The player’s character can act as a supervisor or hire a supervisor. By utilizing the construction bureau buildings, warriors can take over certain tasks for the player, including gathering, transporting, crafting, farming, harvesting, recruiting and training, fishing, and more.  

[h3]5.	Zipline Buildings[/h3]
This includes two building components: the Slide Pole and the Zip Line Pole. By consuming iron chains, the two poles can be connected, allowing players to slide along the rope between the zipline poles using the Slide Pole. With this structure, players will be able to quickly reach their destination.

[h3]6.	Horse Grooming[/h3]
In the stable, players can customize the appearance of their horses. This feature was introduced in the previous developer log, so interested players can refer back to it.

Next week, we will officially announce the release date for the Xizhou Civilization DLC. We also welcome you to continue following Myth of Empires official social media accounts or join our community to participate in discussions.

Myth of Empires – Persia DLC: Weapons Revealed
notes.content:
[h3]The Myth of Empires Persia DLC is set to commence internal functional testing very soon.[/h3] This edition of the developer's log will comprehensively unveil the 13 new weapons added in the DLC. The exquisite designs and profound cultural imprints make each weapon uniquely captivating. Let us together admire the renderings of these weapons and experience the distinctive charm of Persian civilization!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/3b9c370f9f93e203184033ac2daf1fa02f8f2f31.jpg[/img]


White Wolf Waist Knife: The waist knife commonly worn by Bo Ma Wei, named after the ancestral spirits. When charging into battle on horseback, the blade is held flat and swept across, decapitating enemies instantly.

Inferno Hatchet: A battle axe belonging to the immortal troops of Shah. The axe body is intricately engraved, and the handle is inlaid with gold, making it incredibly fierce for breaking shields and armor.

Zhanbo Blossom Hammer: A sturdy one-handed hammer with gardenia patterns adorning the head. The gardenia, known as "Zhanbo" along the Silk Road, is seen by desert tribes as a symbol of the heavens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/31d9e75784d288ae1f9f6e5f4e90a4578e218ef9.jpg[/img]

Khorasan Ripple Blade: A Shah saber crafted through special techniques, with a blade adorned with exquisite, flowing patterns like water.

Radiant Moon Long Axe: A weapon of the Shah Royal Guard, featuring a copper spearhead, a decorated and gold-inlaid axe body. A strong wielder can use this axe to cut through metal plate armor.

Sabo Plate Hammer: The desert tribes refer to their caravan leaders as "Sabo." This is the long hammer belonging to the leader, with its striking surface consisting of vertically arranged steel plates, making it resistant to breakage and extremely destructive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/a821dd78200882d050351dc0b453650d30d9ca17.jpg[/img]

Divine Light Spear: A sharp spearhead capable of easily piercing enemy armor. The Shah people believe that the gods will bestow a divine light upon a true ruler, bringing them the blessings and protection of the divine.

Desert Ocean Spiked Hammer: A long-handled mace with a terrifying array of spikes on the head, effectively reducing the impact area and piercing armor. It is named after the vast, endless desert known as the "Desert Ocean."

Yuefude's Axe: A battle axe made in honor of the monk Yuefude, who once traveled the Silk Road. The axe head features a vajra-like decoration. Legend has it that when Yuefude was about to transcend the cycle of rebirth, he gave up everything, transforming into a dragon and sinking into the earth, all to protect the peace of a temple.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/526ca098d50c1c124efc301a98b392658d886ba4.jpg[/img]

Aghni Horn Bow: The legendary Silk Road was home to countless small kingdoms, and Aghni was one of them. This horn bow from Aghni features longer tips, providing ample draw length and astonishing range.

Chengli Battle Bow: The descendants of the Tuman Khanate call the sky "Chengli." This battle bow, named after the heavens, is a wish that the arrows of its wielder may fly as far as the endless expanse of the sky.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/e1c9f4af5ff05390d942597d14f478d3481639f9.jpg[/img]

Suyab Vine Shield: The edge of this shield is made of layers of intertwined vines, bound together with ox sinew thread, making it both sturdy and lightweight. It is crafted in Suyab, a once-thriving city-state in the Western Regions.

Bulat Hunting Shield: A Shah round shield made of Bulat steel, known for its extreme durability. The shield surface features raised floral patterns inlaid with gold thread, making it highly valuable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/6de25333dc4209c02f568d9732e88841fd10ac74.jpg[/img]

Please follow the official account of Myth of Empires and join the community interactions to be the first to get the latest updates and exciting content about the Persia DLC!

notes.title: Myth of Empires Season 3 Starts November 8!
notes.content:
Myth of Empires Season 3 will officially begin on November 8 and end on January 6, 2025. The seasonal servers for this season will be PVP servers, and will not be region-locked. With the start of the new season, the Official Shop will simultaneously introduce several new Greek civilization outfits and weapon skins, interested players can check them out at that time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/ff334dca049f93e2d04f38c36d84b7a117ea4a73.jpg[/img]
Building on most of the settings from Season 2 and incorporating player feedback and suggestions, Season 3 will further optimize aspects like cross-server mechanics and multiplier settings. We believe that the adjustments will enhance the overall experience, making it more balanced. Detailed rules and settings will be announced before the start of Season 3.

Here are the main differences and adjustments for Season 3:
[h2]I.	Increased resource gathering multipliers to shorten the growth process[/h2]
In the first week, fourth week, and eighth week, the resource gathering multipliers (base values) will receive significantly higher boosts. This means that whether players join at the start of the season or midway through, their growth process will be greatly accelerated, allowing them to quickly gather battle resources and focus more on strategy development and cooperative combat.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/2c576a703adbc5701f5fec85810ebb06d8f5710b.jpg[/img]

[h2]II.	The activation time for cross-county, cross-prefecture, and map Boundary Markers will be moved forward[/h2]
In the first week, the cross-server restriction will remain in place, but the activation times for cross-county and cross-prefecture will be moved forward: cross-county will be available in the second week, and cross-prefecture in the third week. Similarly, the time for activating all map Boundary Markers will be advanced to the third week. Players will need to adapt to the faster-paced changes in gameplay for the new season.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/ed5b3af040f4446263e65ad263cd7483560490e9.jpg[/img]

[h2]III.	Various optimizations will be implemented to enhance the offensive and defensive battle experience[/h2]
In Season 3, the damage caused by Flamethrowers will be doubled, but the attack damage of Beast Lords and Feimeng Cannon Ammo will be slightly reduced. Additionally, the damage dealt by Ballista will be significantly lowered.

When Watchtowers and Boundary Marker structures are attacked, the damage will also be doubled, unlike Season 2, Watchtowers in Season 3 can only be placed after unlocking the corresponding guild recipes. Conversely, the damage taken by the Grizzly King when attacked by Watchtowers will be reduced, and the damage to structures inside caves will also be adjusted downward to provide some survival space in the caves.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/f0a600649e09d841d4f463114265b20f76a1a09d.jpg[/img]

[h2]IV.	Upgrading seasonal tally order will be easier, with the required experience reduced by 30%[/h2]
The adjusted seasonal tally order rewards will be more abundant and diverse. Additionally, with the change that reduces the experience required to upgrade by 30%, players will be able to earn higher-value item rewards in a shorter time, alleviating concerns about completing tasks but facing difficulties due to experience gaps.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/51c65c1356c9e303d47c53c539fca43dc1e54aa7.jpg[/img]

[h2]V.	Other adjustments[/h2]
In addition to the aforementioned changes, the base HP multiplier for horses and the durability of Giant Kongming Lantern will be further enhanced in Season 3. Furthermore, the number of lanterns appearing on the Zhongzhou map will be increased, and the Guild Shop's Copper Coin Shop will now offer Premium Farmland and High-quality Replenishing Food for sale. There are many more exciting changes to look forward to.

This concludes the main introduction to the new Season 3 of Myth of Empires. If you have any other thoughts or expectations for this season, feel free to engage with us through the official community. The Persia DLC is also in development as planned, and we welcome your feedback.

notes.title: Myth of Empires Season 2 Starts August 16!
notes.content:
Myth of Empires Season 2 will officially begin on August 16 at 14:00 and will end on October 15 at 00:00. The seasonal servers for this season will be PVP servers, and will not be region-locked.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/f55924215b0c5b7de69ff40c3c3e04f7c3dec894.jpg[/img]

Compared to Season 1, Season 2 will further improve the overall game tempo and make combat more satisfying. Adjustments and optimizations will be made based on the various suggestions put forward by players during Season 1, resulting in a season more oriented toward battlefield coordination and strategy as a whole, with a reduced emphasis on the upgrading process.
Here are some of the new adjustments that will be featured in Season 2:

[h2]I.Faster Gameplay, Bigger Gains[/h2]
While Season 1 had a level cap of Level 45 for its first two weeks, Season 2 will raise its level cap to Level 60 in its second week, which will reduce the level constraints of the character growth process. There will also be more ways to obtain Copper Coins, including lanterns that can be looted for a 100% chance to earn Honor and Copper Coins, as well as increased profits from trade. Characters will start with 100,000 Honor, and subsequent Honor will be more convenient to obtain, making it easier to upgrade your Nobility. The amount of time it takes to upgrade Civilization Levels will be significantly reduced, and forging speed will be substantially increased. Season 2 will feature the same initial Comprehension and Recipe Points given to new characters in Season 1, which when combined with the changes mentioned above, means characters will progress faster than ever before! Of course, the new season will also implement the 90% reduction in building damage for the first 7 days of the season, as well as the weekly increase in Boundary Marker protection times featured in Season 1, providing players with more protection early on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/26f95ad9b4f5acf00572098fc1c802cde46c29ad.jpg[/img]

[h2]II.More Ways to Obtain Beast Lord Summoning Items, Stronger Creatures[/h2]
In response to player feedback on the difficulty of obtaining Beast Lords, Season 2 will feature new ways to obtain Beast Lord summoning items to improve the chances that players can capture them. Additionally, the HP, Attack, and Movement Speed of Beast Lords has been improved along with the overall experience of riding and controlling them. The melee damage and recovery rates of elephants have been strengthened as well, and the experience of using them in combat has been optimized.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/fc337e1528a523e972623285ed574b95b7fb2145.jpg[/img]

[h2]III.Strengthened Large Siege Weapons, More Difficult Cave Survival[/h2]
Siege warfare in Season 2 will be more intense, with Giant Kongming Lanterns getting a 300% durability boost, the damage of Feiming Cannons being enhanced, and the shield-breaking rate of arrow towers being improved.

Additionally, in certain caves, buildings will take 5x more damage, and damage dealt by arrow towers will be halved. Survival in these caves will be difficult indeed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/0e4a0e36719547ca66cec1b082d0a0ddd292c28c.jpg[/img]

[h2]IV. Season Rewards[/h2]
The rules for receiving rewards will be the same in Season 2 as they were in Season 1, but the rewards themselves will be slightly different. Season Points earned in a season can be exchanged for items in the following season. Guilds that receive 250,000 Season Points will receive skins, with the top 10 guilds in the points rankings receiving exclusive skins. Contribution received after the season ends can be exchanged for items on non-seasonal servers. After the end of the season, players will be able to seal 1 warrior and 1 mount that they can then use in the following season.

[h2]V.Other Rules[/h2]
In addition to the above, there are other settings that will carry over from Season 1, including smaller alliance sizes, increased acquisition of molotov cocktails, the ability to purchase Level 45 and Level 60 attribute-less weapons and armor, Honor, Arts of War, molotov cocktail recipes, and more. We will be announcing more detailed season rules in a future announcement, so stay tuned!

If you have any suggestions or feedback for this season, or you want to learn more, feel free to submit them in our official communities.

notes.title: Hellenic Civilization DLC is Live! New All-time Low Discount for Steam Summer!
notes.content:
The moment Myth of Empires fans have long been waiting for has finally arrived - the Hellenic Civilization Pack is here! This pack brings Hellas, a civilization with an ancient Greek theme, to the world of Myth of Empires, and represents the first in a series of DLCs that will introduce new civilizations to the game. This pack includes 12 armor sets, 15 special weapons, a full set of new building recipes, 1 warship, 6 musical instruments, and 5 new building platforms/objects. At the same time, we’ve also added Civilization Traits to the game. Players will be able to activate the trait trees of civilizations they unlock to obtain bonuses unique to those civilizations.

Myth of Empires - Hellenic Civilization Pack: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3042590]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3042590[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/3cb761954489eff91e2e65faa6747777655a41b9.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=3qpoXMCjyP4;full][/previewyoutube]

To coincide with the DLC’s release, Myth of Empires will also be participating in the Steam Summer Sale at an all-time low discount! From June 27 at 5:00 PM until July 11 at 5:00 PM (all times UTC), the Myth of Empires base game and Dongzhou Map DLC will be available for 60% off, while the Royal Carriages Pack and Musical Instruments Pack DLCs will be available for 30% off. At the same time, the new Hellenic Civilization Pack will be available at a 10%-off discounted price of $11.69! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/2da8fceb258abe9f0b6800f68e418b925e17087c.jpg[/img]

In addition, for the duration of the Summer Sale, Myth of Empires will also be holding Server Multiplier Events, and Login Level Reward Events. During the latter event, you will be able to claim different levels of rewards by logging in to the game. Stay tuned to official event announcements for news on additional events!

The Hellenic Civilization Pack includes the following content:

[h2]12 New Sets of Armor[/h2]

These new sets of armor are made using the game’s six main armor materials: wood, bronze, iron, steel, black iron, and meteoric iron; each material has a light armor set and a heavy armor set, making 12 Hellenic sets of armor altogether.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/e103b16dbf4fb2fd29662a2d932803018d3e4493.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/b66859ac4810a6ab2afd0fbccab891df09a3ce43.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/80d3128ee2eaebc2044c1096986de7b8cc734a2a.jpg[/img]


[h2]15 Special Weapons[/h2]

These weapons include the Xiphos (a bronze one-handed sword), the Spartan Dory (a bronze poleaxe blade), the Spear of Promachos (an iron poleaxe blade), the Isle of Ash Bow, the Epsilon Axe (an iron one-handed axe), the Mycenaean Rapier (a steel two-handed sword), the Labrys of Hades (a black iron poleaxe), the Decapitator (a black iron two-handed axe), the Tauros (a meteoric iron one-handed blunt weapon), the Lycean Mallet (a meteoric iron long-handled blunt weapon), the Figure-of-Eight Shield (a tower shield), and the Aspis Shield.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/8cf59a81a0ca2810ba713ffdd1bc3af55eae6cd7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/3a3078f53f2e964efe5b10a6332548de34f3afd6.jpg[/img]


[h2]Full Set of Building Recipes[/h2]

The Sacred Palm building components include fort walls, gates, foundations, ceilings, roofs, stairs, windows, and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/e4b68918c30673abf42bf50b40ee36aae066eba0.jpg[/img]

[h2]5 Types of Building Platforms/Objects[/h2]

These include Hephaestus's Forge, Hephaestus's Armor Bench, the Sacred Furnace, the Brazen Bull, and Pandora’s Box, totaling 5 buildings comprised of workbenches, a torture rack, and a storage chest. The new forge, armor bench, and furnace all have two crafting queues each, increasing their crafting efficiency. For its part, the Brazen Bull increases a warrior’s Obedience more quickly. Finally, Pandora’s Box not only has a large storage space, it is also a trap that can unleash various effects on whomever breaks it or tries to open it without permission.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/21ab7b46cc3656af5facb6d1ba1ae43a56a3c160.jpg[/img]


[h2]6 Types of Hellenic Musical Instruments[/h2]

New instruments include Athena’s Auros (a double reed auros), the Tympanon (a type of tambourine), Hermes’s Lyre, the Heart of Anacreon (a kind of barbitus), the Pandean Pipes (a type of pan flute), and the Salpinx, totaling 6 unique musical instruments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/b17a6974ba6310b25f72f81e842689c2ed986a7e.jpg[/img]


[h2]1 Warship[/h2]

The pack also includes the Bireme warship.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/756022394d40befcddaf2557819b51790239f98f.jpg[/img]

In addition to the content exclusive to the DLC pack, civilization trait trees have also been added to the game. Players can activate different civilization trait trees to deepen their own areas of expertise. For instance, the Jiuzhou civilization (the new name given to the civilization already in the game) is good at making crossbows, planting, and building fortresses, while Hellas is more proficient in sailing and the use of spears and shields. Based on your progress with a given civilization, you can increase your civilization’s Integration, which provides additional attribute bonuses, including bonuses to melee, ranged, and siege damage; character damage reduction; max HP; related bonuses for the warriors under your command; and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/743fdd077a5cf13e9a011590576879e585728e2b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/fe84b182306e336b02630a308141e4bb98ad9a2b.jpg[/img]

Of course, plenty of more exciting things are waiting to be discovered in-game. The next civilization, which will be based on Persia, is undergoing development and is expected to be released later this year. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Myth of Empires Season 1 Begins May 25!
notes.content:
The release of the global season servers for Myth of Empires V1.0 is upon us, with Season 1 launching on May 25 at 14:00 UTC! This season is planned to last 2 months, with the season coming to a close on July 29 at 00:00 UTC. All seasonal servers will be non-region-locked PVP servers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/cfc9ad6934152f8f9b70d011ffbc9342c44c6b3e.png[/img]

At the same time, Myth of Empires will be taking part in Steam’s Open World Survival Crafting Fest! From May 28 through June 4, Myth of Empires and all of its DLC will be 30% off, with some of the skin Blind Boxes on sale for 10% off!

This will be the first season since the game’s full release. Season 1’s Seasonal Servers will feature the following adjustments to gameplay:

[h3]1. Faster Character Growth. [/h3]
On the Seasonal Servers, characters will develop more quickly. Resource collection rates, Proficiency and Honor acquisition rates, taming speed, maximum Guild Activity, and Carrying Capacity will all be significantly boosted, while the amount of Copper Coins required for Expertise breakthrough, the time required to craft items, and the time required for horses to revive have all been significantly reduced. In addition, equipped items and items carried in the shortcut bar will not drop when a character dies, but will instead suffer a 10% reduction in Durability, making the character development process easier for players.

[h3]2. Phased Protection. [/h3]
For the first week, there will be a 90% reduction in building damage. For the first two weeks, the level cap will be set to Level 45. For the four weeks, Mangonels and ballista-type siege weapons will only deal 25% damage, but will begin dealing 100% of their normal damage starting in Week 5. Boundary Markers will offer longer protection times on Seasonal Servers, but toward the end of the season, the positions of Boundary Markers will be displayed on each county’s map. These measures are designed to offer a certain degree of protection for players in the early period of the season, balancing character development and ensuring that the battlefield competitions that will occur in the later stages of the season will be more fair.

[h3]3. Weapon and Siege Weapon Balances.[/h3]
Battering Rams will deal significantly more damage, and the Durability losses they suffer when attacking will be reduced. The Durability loss suffered by offensive weapons attached to elephant and rhino saddles will be reduced as well. Heavy Ballistas and Simple Ballistas will not have 100% accuracy when operated by NPC warriors. Certain normal-quality weapons and armor, Art of War Gift Boxes, Construction Blueprints, Abrasives, Quenchants, and Molotov Cocktails will all be available for purchase at the Guild Shop using Copper Coins. These balances are aimed at encouraging players to participate in the intense battles sure to occur in the later stages of the season!

[h3]4.A Plethora of Season Rewards. [/h3]
For this season, we have expanded the number of guilds that can join a single alliance, while limiting the total alliance member limit to 50 players. When the season ends, guilds that have earned 250,000 Season Points will earn skins, with the top 10 guilds receiving exclusive skins. Contribution earned during the season can be exchanged for related items at Guild Shops on non-Seasonal Servers. In contrast to previous seasons during the Early Access period, at the end of this season, players will be able to choose one hero and one mount to keep for use in the following season (though players will need to reach a certain level to do this).

Here are the detailed settings for Season 1 servers:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/322641ec6451135eb2b7f613787ba32bf26ead37.png[/img]

We look forward to seeing you in the world of Myth of Empires!

notes.title: Myth of Empires Season 1 - Season Rules Sneak Peek Part II
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/cfc9ad6934152f8f9b70d011ffbc9342c44c6b3e.png[/img]

Season 1 of Myth of Empires Seasonal Servers begins this Saturday, May 25. In the previous announcement, we covered rules and settings related to the pace of the game, resource collection multipliers, and seasonal rewards. Today, we’ll take a look at rules covering mounts, siege equipment, the Guild Shop, Boundary Markers, and some equipment.

Here are some of the specific rules that will be applied on the Seasonal Servers:

[olist]
[*] For the first 4 weeks of the season, damage dealt by Mangonels and Ballista-type siege equipment will be reduced to 25%. Starting from Week 5, their damage will be increased to 100%.
[*] Heavy Ballistas and Simple Ballistas will no longer have 100% accuracy when operated by warriors.
[*] Battering Rams will deal significantly more damage.
[*] Toward the end of the season, the positions of Boundary Markers will be displayed on each county’s map.
[*] In some areas, players will not be able to construct buildings higher than Level 84.
[*] The revival time of warriors and horses placed in buildings will be reduced by 80%.
[*] Humanoid NPCs will respawn more quickly. The respawn time of Dragon-patterned and Elite NPCs will be reduced by 80%, and their Hostility will increase more quickly.
[*] The Durability loss of offensive weapons attached to elephant and rhino saddles incurred when attacking will be reduced by 80%.
[*] The Durability loss of Battering Rams incurred when attacking will be reduced by 80%.
[/olist]

In addition, more items will be available at the Guild Shop for purchase using Copper Coins (you will need to reach a certain level before you can purchase some items). These items include:

[list]
[*] Certain steel and meteoric iron armor and weapons. This items are all normal quality and have base Durability.
[*] Art of War Gift Boxes and Construction Blueprints, as well as some of the more common Abrasives and Quenchants.
[*] Molotov Cocktails.
[/list]

We will announce more Seasonal Server rules prior to their launch, so stay tuned. Players who have questions or feedback about these rules should feel free to reach out to us on our official communities.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/cfc9ad6934152f8f9b70d011ffbc9342c44c6b3e.png[/img]

Season 1 of Myth of Empires Seasonal Servers begins this Saturday, May 25. In the meantime, we have put together a list of new rules and settings that will be applied on these servers. Players who have questions or feedback about these rules should feel free to reach out to us on our official communities.

Here are some of the specific rules that will be applied to the Seasonal Servers:

[list]
[*] Every time a character levels up, all of its weapon and armor-type proficiencies will increase by 15 levels.
[*] The rate at which non-combat proficiency is acquired is increased 5 times.
[*] Guild Activity and its upper limit is increased 3 times.
[*] The rate at which Honor is acquired is significantly increased, and there are more ways to acquire it.
[*] Copper Coins required to breakthrough Expertise are reduced by 90%.
[*] The time required to craft items is reduced by 90%.
[*] 50 Recipe Points and 50 Comprehension are granted upon character creation.
[*] Resource collection output multiplier is increased to 3x or higher.
[*] The Carrying Capacity of characters, warriors, mounts, and carriages is significantly increased.
[*] Copper Coins acquired from NPCs and resource collection are increased and are not subject to daily limits.
[*] The amount of Silk Moths collected is significantly increased.
[*] When a character dies, items in equipment slots and on the shortcut bar will not drop, and will instead lose 10% Durability.
[*] Seasonal Servers have longer Boundary Marker protection times than other servers.
[*] Shields lose less Durability when attacked by watchtowers, and damage taken upon penetrations is reduced.
[*] Expanded the number of guilds an alliance can have, while imposing a 50-player limit on alliances.
[*] Players who reach 250,000 points this season will get exclusive seasonal skins, which can be used on other official servers and custom servers.
[*] Merits will be awarded at the end of the season based on the number of points players receive. These Merits can be exchanged for various items in the Guild Shop on non-seasonal servers.
[/list]

The Seasonal Servers will also have other adjustments to mounts, equipment, the Guild Shop, Boundary Marker mechanics, and more. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Myth of Empires Season 1 Launches 5/25!
notes.content:
Dear players,

We are thrilled to announce that Season 1 of Myth of Empires V1.0’s global seasonal servers will launch on May 25 at 14:00 UTC and end on July 29 at midnight. All seasonal servers will be non-region-locked PVP servers. Prior to the launch of Season 1, from May 18 at midnight until May 20, we will be holding Double Proficiency events for both characters and warriors on Classic Era, New Era, and Jade Era servers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/778fb5b4a73e40700cefeb5241ffb9ccece82592.jpg[/img]

How will the seasonal servers differ from the servers already in the game? Seasonal servers offer four major gameplay changes:

[h2]I.Faster Growth, Less Grind[/h2]
Compared to the seasonal servers previously available in the Early Access version of the game, character progress on the seasonal servers in V1.0 will be quicker and smoother. New characters will start with Comprehension and Recipe Points. Upon death, equipped armor and weapons will not drop, instead suffering a slight Durability loss. Basic resource production, taming speed, breeding speed, Honor, and Guild Activity will all be boosted, and these boosts will only increase as the season progresses. Skill Books will not be required to unlock new skills. Combat Proficiency will automatically increase along with your character’s level. Honor will be easier to acquire. Finally, Copper Coins obtained from NPCs and resource taxation will be increased as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/0959f1e175d5a189099c3821eb983356d9fc51c4.jpg[/img]

[h2]II. A Smoother Experience[/h2]
For the first week, there will be a 90% reduction in building damage. For the first two weeks, the level cap will be set to Level 45. For the first month, certain siege equipment will have reduced damage. These restrictions will be lifted as they expire. These limitations are designed to help alleviate the issue of excessive early development leading to over-powered forces gaining an unbeatable advantage. They provide better early protection and lay the foundation for more evenly-matched battlefield competitions in the later stages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/d807e1ad797d14ee0a91667dd3e07b89beaf7ea9.jpg[/img]

[h2]III.Weapon and Siege Balancing[/h2]
We have also made some adjustments to weapons and siege equipment to make combat more balanced. Certain siege weapons will have significantly reduced damage for the first month, while the damage of Battering Rams will be boosted. Shields, the damage of ranged weapons, and the usefulness of certain mounts on battlefields have all been enhanced, while Heavy Ballistas and ballistas powered by warriors are no longer guaranteed hits. In addition, more useful items will be available for purchase using Copper Coins at the Guild Shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/d6738b894a8d220a466e7fbf0844c55c7ede4647.jpg[/img]

[h2]IV.Season Points and Rewards[/h2]
We’ve also made some adjustments to the ways that seasonal rewards are calculated. Season Points can be exchanged for items when the following season begins. Guilds that receive 250,000 Season Points will earn skins, with the top 10 guilds receiving exclusive skins. Contribution earned at the end of the season can be exchanged for related items on non-seasonal servers. In contrast to previous seasons, at the end of this season, players will be able to choose one hero and one mount to keep for use in the following season.

That’s all we have to share about Season 1 for now. If you have any feedback or suggestions, feel free to share it with us on official communities!

notes.title: The Largest Event in Myth of Empires’ History is About to Begin! Join the Party!
notes.content:
Myth of Empires V1.0 made its Steam debut on February 22. To celebrate this momentous occasion, we will be holding the Assembly of Warriors event on February 24 and 25 to challenge current server population limits!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/b526104efa07ed92b3a4a99b42455d68f4e36547.jpg[/img]

This event will be launched on exclusive Festival Celebration servers, and players all over the world can participate. Players will enjoy splendid fireworks, the enchanting aurora, and colorful lanterns, and will be able to traverse this wonderful world using portals and launchers. In addition, players will be able to claim up to 6 Festival Celebration Chests, which contain random character skins and decorations.

But this event is about more than just celebrating the release of Myth of Empires. The development team hopes to use this event to once again push the limits of what the Unreal Engine can achieve, in preparation for the “Thousand Man Battlefield” and large-scale Season Servers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/f12960a1bc42305fd6ba26ce6d466c231b6a91cb.jpg[/img]

In order to bring massive historical battles to life, it is important to break through the Unreal Engine’s 100-player server limit. The Myth of Empires development team is hard at work on this problem. In May 2023, we held a 200 player Skirmish Battle stress test, to break through the original soft limit of 60 players online at the same time and bring it all the way up to 200. The test was a resounding success, and we even managed to push 300-500 players! This time, we’re shooting for the stars: 10,000 players on the same server at the same time!

[b]How to join: [/b]

Players will be able to join the event via "Events – Festival Celebration" in the "Myth of Empires" game, or select "Festival Celebration" from the events list at the top right corner of the county list. A total of 3 games will be opened. Specific opening times are as follows:

[list]
[*] Asia-Pacific: February 24 from 13:00-14:00 UTC
[*] Europe: February 24 from 19:00-20:00 UTC
[*] Americas: February 25 from 01:00-02:00 UTC
[/list]

These three events are all open to players worldwide. For every 15 minutes you participate in the events, you will earn a Festival Celebration Chest. You can earn 2 Festival Celebration Chests from each event, for a total of 6 Chests across all three events. Rewards you open from these chests can be viewed in your warehouse from the main menu or in your Steam inventory. We hope you have fun in this event!

For such a small development team, the road to bringing Myth of Empires online has been a long and challenging one. However, the dream underlying the game has never changed. Angela Game will continue to work its hardest to bring a more complete and immersive gaming experience to its players!

Myth of Empires V1.0 is on sale now for a launch-week 10% discounted price of $35.99. Interested players can buy or wishlist the game here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1371580/Myth_of_Empires/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1371580/Myth_of_Empires/[/url]

notes.title: Myth of Empires V1.0 is Now Available!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Myth of Empires V1.0 released today, February 21, at 17:00 UTC. Myth of Empires V1.0 costs $39.99, with a launch week 10% discounted price of $35.99. New county servers will be opened in batches on February 21 at 17:00 UTC, and on February 22 at 02:00 and 12:00 UTC.

The release of the game is accompanied by the new Dongzhou map DLC (free), and a DLC pack containing ten musical instruments, including the dizi, guqin, se, pan flute, pipa, sheng, suona, xun, konghou, and chime bells. Players can play these instruments as they wish, or even upload custom MIDI tracks to play.

Players who already own the game, including players who purchased the original Early Access version on Steam and players who purchased the International Vanguard Edition, will be able to play Myth of Empires V1.0 without any additional purchases, though they will need to manually claim the free Dongzhou map DLC. These players will receive a commemorative skin: Wu’an General’s Armor.

Watch the Myth of Empires V1.0 trailer:
[previewyoutube=Mu-obfH5qhM;full][/previewyoutube]

Myth of Empires V1.0 brings players a whole new gaming experience. In addition to the map featured in the Early Access version of the game, V1.0 allows players to explore Dongzhou, an island map with a variety of new landforms to explore. V1.0 also introduces sea and air travel, allowing players to wage wars in innovative ways. The construction system has been expanded, as has the taming system; players will now be able to tame virtually any beast they find in-game. PVE gameplay has been expanded, new server options have been added, and modding is now possible, too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/b1436ea01ee77d92ef6e4b1ad6d72dd6f10b04fa.jpg[/img]

[h2]Embark upon a new adventure on the free Dongzhou map[/h2]
Behold the new Dongzhou map, which will be featured alongside the original map players experienced during Myth of Empires’ Early Access period. The new map is home to volcanoes, picturesque isles, sandy shores, ice floes, and bamboo forests. It also carries over the original map’s realistic day-night cycle, diverse ecosystems, and varied cultures of NPCs that have made the game such a hit among its devoted following.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/9c03233149640d624b7a5bdf76604428c7bd36c0.png[/img]

[h2]Wage war by land, air, and sea[/h2]
Myth of Empires V1.0 includes not only a large number of land-based vehicles of war such as siege wagons, ballistas, and catapults, it also adds gliders, giant sky lanterns, warships, and more. This opens up whole new domains to conquer and adds a wealth of new options to your burgeoning empire’s arsenal, but also makes combat more complex and challenging.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/fa5390f1b0729d2221002a64ab26b2125b6bdd04.png[/img]

[h2]Build your empire from the ground up[/h2]
Myth of Empires features a variety of structures made of wood, clay, stone, and metal. These include more than ten types of structures that can be transformed to meet your design needs. There are also different decorative items such as skins, lighting, and furniture to make you feel at home. Whether you want to build a modest farmhouse, a rustic town, or even a massive imperial city-state, Myth of Empires makes it possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/291c5343eea9695cf2bced9ce6244c5e7c36bce9.png[/img]

[h2]A wealth of crafting recipes, with plenty of new additions[/h2]
Myth of Empires features 1,300+ crafting recipes, covering everything from structures, tools, work benches, equipment, and weapons, to taming implements and culinary instruments. V1.0 features new animal-powered, semi-automated production and warfare equipment. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/e4ed457b10385d9a67bc146ff2a317aa2175fefc.png[/img]

[h2]A menagerie of tameable beasts[/h2]
Taming has always been one of the key features of Myth of Empires. In V1.0, animals now have new attributes that can be inherited and strengthened through breeding. In addition, Beast Lords can also be tamed to enhance your abilities in combat. Nearly all of the creatures in the world of Myth of Empires can be tamed to fight alongside you in battle, for transport, or to help you with resource collection and production.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/0ce4c6b3aae14a9928a24f55580c026eaf766cc5.png[/img]

[h2]Large-scale cross-server battles[/h2]
Myth of Empires’ unique system of administrative regions such as counties and commanderies gives the game an epic feel. Through cross-server battles and large-scale battlefields like County Battles, Prefecture Battles, and Fortress Battles, players expand their territory, hoping to etch their empire’s name in the annals of history. In the future, new Season Servers will be launched to provide an even richer variety and wealth of battlefields to the game.

[h2]More PVE gameplay[/h2]
V1.0 enriches the game’s PVE content with classic musical instruments to play, as well as servants who can dance for you. You can also simulate massive battles with new PVE siege training and bandit raids, collect free skins as you play the game, and accumulate proficiency bonuses, even from the game’s lobby.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/e9563049b9eee6c97112ca31a3b0c59f53353141.png[/img]

[h2]More events[/h2]
To celebrate the launch of V1.0 as well as the upcoming Lantern Festival, we will be holding a Lantern Festival event in-game with rewards for players to collect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/c241c94096d88e15216deb853d941ff2104797df.png[/img]

[h2]New personal server modes[/h2]
In addition to official servers, Myth of Empires V1.0 also includes five personal server modes. These include solo mode, LAN, and online servers, featuring single servers and even server clusters. Players will be able to enjoy the game however they want. In addition to the Asian, North American, and European servers available in the Early Access version of the game, we are also adding official servers in the Oceania and South America regions, bringing everyone a smooth gaming experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/adbb84cb1cbfc83218afe5bb15c6d792da5c458e.jpg[/img]

[h2]A robust mod editor[/h2]
Myth of Empires V1.0 features a mod editor. The possibilities are now endless! All modders are welcome.

[h2]Future development plans: additional civilizations![/h2]
New civilizations are coming, Persian, Greek, and Egyptian civilizations, with all of the new structures, weapons, tools, and equipment that entails.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/6daad9b876b3a96f111572bf3d73fb5407d8d2b1.jpg[/img]

The V1.0 release marks the beginning of a new era for Myth of Empires. Whether you are a fan of sandbox games, medieval-style combat games, or simply love building structures, taming animals, and exploring dangerous yet exciting worlds, Myth of Empires is the game for you!

Join our Discord: [url=discord.gg/mythofempires]discord.gg/mythofempires[/url]

notes.title: Become a Myth of Empires Influencer NOW!
notes.content:
[h2]Calling all creators![/h2]

We are happy to announce that Myth of Empires' Content Creator Partner Program is entering its second phase to coincide with the game's V1.0 release! In this program, we provide benefits to creators who are interested in Myth of Empires and willing to invest their time in playing and promoting the game. We offer events, keys, and more. All content creators already on the Myth of Empires Discord who have received the Content Creator role will continue to be enrolled in this program. 

To participate, visit the official Myth of Empires website ([url=https://www.mythofempires.com/]https://www.mythofempires.com/[/url]), click Creators Sign Up at the top of the page, and fill out the Google Form. Once you've finished, reach out to laughinghunter on our Discord to become a Myth of Empires Content Creator.

[b]Content Creators are free to participate in one or more of the three following events:[/b]

[b]Event 1: Creator Contest  Event Period: 2/21-4/1 0:00 UTC[/b]
Content Creator's last three videos or broadcasts must have been posted in the last three months and have 2000 views on average to qualify. Inactive channels will not be considered.

Participants need to add the tracking link to the description of their Myth of Empires video or livestream, or post it on their social media or communities. These tracking links will record the number of clicks, wishlist additions, and purchases; this data will be used to score this event. In addition, participants will need to send links to their videos/livestreams to laughinghunter, as view data will also be included in the scoring.

We will calculate the final results of the event on 3/31 at 24:00 UTC, and announce the winners as well as their scores on 4/1. Appeals can be submitted for the 24-hour period following the results announcement. The first place prize is $5000 USD, second place is $2000 USD, and third place is $1000 USD. These rewards will be sent by wire transfer.

[b]Event 2: Livestream Frenzy  Event Period: 2/21-3/25 0:00 UTC[/b]
Registered Content Creators who stream Myth of Empires for 30 hours total on 4 different days within a week, can contact laughinghunter before the following Wednesday to receive 2 Myth of Empires game keys.

[b]Event 3: Creator Frenzy  Event Period: 2/21-3/21 0:00 UTC[/b]
When Content Creators publish Myth of Empires livestreams and videos, add #Moe and @Myth of Empires to participate in this event. Each participant will have up to 10 chances to publish content to attend the event.

Content Creators will earn a reward for every 300 views all their contents within the event get. Each creator can receive up to 10 rewards.

We will calculate and distribute rewards every two weeks. Participants will have two prizes to choose from each time: a $10 Steam gift card, or 6500 in-game Gold Tokens.

We will announce more events in the next two weeks. We welcome all content creators to show off their work in our community!

2. There will be 3 batches of servers to be introduced on 17:00 Feb 21, 02:00 and 12:00 Feb 22 UTC. We will open ASIA, OCE, EU, NA, and SA servers depending on the actual server load.
3. There will be some region-blocked servers in Prefecture 43 (ASIA), 60 (EU), 29(NA), 61(OCE), 23(SA).

[h2]Region Block Servers[/h2]
All region block servers are filtered by the region of the player’s Steam account. For example, if your Steam account is in China, then you will be able to enter ASIA region-blocked servers, but you can not enter NA and EU region-blocked servers. 

[h2]EA Cosmetic Reward[/h2]
To all of our Early Access players, thank you so much for your support and we will send Wuan General Armor Suit to all EA players. (tradable at steam market)
Event Time: 17:00 Feb 21 - 16:00 May 22 UTC
Qualified Players: EA participants
Event Details: after you log in to the game, every 8 hours will grant you a piece of the Wuan General Suit. There will be 3 different pieces of the whole skin set. Rewards will be sent to your Steam account automatically when you meet the requirement and restart the client.

[h2]Anti-Cheat Measures Upgrade[/h2]
Myth of Empires will adopt a new set of Anti-Cheat measures. It will be both effective on official servers and dedicated servers that opened the Anti-Cheat switch. We will take a 0 tolerance policy against all cheaters and hackers.

We understand that cheating has a serious impact on the fairness of the game and the user experience, so we have been working hard to strengthen anti-cheating measures. The anti-cheat program will provide us with more efficient and accurate cheating detection and blocking tools. At the same time, we will also strengthen the manual review mechanism to ensure that all ban decisions are confirmed by rigorous review.

Under the new anti-cheating system, we will strictly crack down on any form of cheating, including but not limited to plug-ins, cheaters, malicious cracking, and so on. Once the above cheating behavior is found, we will immediately take measures to block the offending user, and they will be added to the Steam platform VAC ban list, banned players will not be able to access the official server, custom server, and single/host mode.

We believe that only by safeguarding the fairness and healthy development of the game can players truly enjoy the game.

At the same time, we will update the game fair play announcement after the V1.0 update, at which time you can have a look at the game client.

Thank you all for being so supportive!

Myth of Empires Development Team

notes.content:

[*] Added the vehicle Giant kongming Lantern and related recipes. You can ride the giant kongming lantern for flying. Available at Guild Shop - Siege Points Store. 
[*] Added repeating cannons (anti-aircraft), Toxic Ballista, and automatic flamethrowers, along with related recipes.
[*] Added wooden and clay spiked walls and relevant recipes for them.

[*] Added the Food Box and related recipes. After placing food in the food gift box, you can put it on the market for trading.

[*] Added mechanical gathering tools and recipes.
[*] Added the Wooden Kite Launcher and related recipes. Players can ride the wooden kite for gliding or transport some goods with certain limitations.
