[*] Added a subpage in the warrior interface for mine-covering buildings, showing the owned mine covers and the construction limits.
[*] Added the envoy function. Dispatch followers through the envoy camp; the dispatched area needs to be opened by neutral camp NPCs and quests.
[*] Added skin’s decorative function, you can choose skins when placing a decoration base
[*] Added level 50 and 60 polearm/hammers, and related recipes.
[*] Added playing function for musical instruments. 
[*] Added flag base and related recipes. Various flags can be placed on the base, and different placement methods can be switched.
[*] Added mechanical storage box and related recipes. This box can hold single-item props, with a stack quantity of 10 million (for some stackable props only).
[*] Added trap-type storage buildings and related recipes. Appearance is the same as normal storage buildings, but items cannot be stored inside. Destroying this building will cause explosions, hidden weapons, poison gas, etc., within its range.
[*] Added Smithing Table and related recipes. Weapons, armor, tools, and throwing objects can gain forge attributes, items with forging attributes will not disappear when the durability is 0 (throwing weapons already stacked cannot be stacked again after hammering).
[*] Added combat skill system. Skills can be obtained through hammering attributes of weapons. Use weapons with combat skills, and press Z/X keys to trigger skills when anger value meets the requirements. Anger value can be increased through combat.
[*] Added robustness attribute, obtained through forge equipment. When repairing, the robustness value is deducted first to perfectly repair the equipment (without deducting the durability limit). When the remaining robustness value is insufficient for a single repair deduction or becomes 0, repairing the equipment will affect its durability limit.
[*] Added Enhanced Mating function for stables. Successfully bred horses can evolve and inherit evolution. There is a chance to obtain new horse skills through Enhanced Mating.
[*] Added active skills for horses, obtained through stable enhancement breeding. Ctrl+Q can be used to activate this skill (equipping active skills is required for use).
[*] Added skills and attributes for animals in the animal pen. Placing them in vehicles enhances vehicle attributes.
[*] NPCs now have a chance to drop tools of lvl.70 forging level and below quality.
[*] Added daily challenge gameplay, available in neutral camps. Five random tasks can be completed daily.
[*] Added the Beast lord gameplay.

[*] Added Beast Lord Training function, you can unlock the Taming Ground through the Guild Tech. Using Taming Ground to train the Beast Lord will improve its attributes.

[*] Added warriors envoy function, available at the warrior's camp. You can upgrade the rewards through different area’s neutral NPC camps.

[*] Added Guild Depot redemption function, adding "Personal Items" tab (backpack dropped when the character dies) and "Force Items" tab (backpack dropped when the guild’s safe is destroyed). After the lost items are deleted by the system, they can be redeemed by consuming copper coins and can exist for a maximum of 7 days.

notes.title: Myth of Empires V1.0 Extended Gameplay Trailer!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We have been busy getting ready for the Myth of Empires V1.0 release on February 21, and we have a new trailer to share with you! This one’s three-and-a-half minutes long, so strap in!

[previewyoutube=9mbKlZrCNPg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Embark upon a new adventure on the free Dongzhou map[/h2]

This trailer gives an exciting glimpse into the new Dongzhou map, which will be featured alongside the original map players experienced during Myth of Empires’ Early Access period. The new map is home to volcanoes, picturesque isles, sandy shores, ice floes, and bamboo forests. It also carries over the original map’s realistic day-night cycle, diverse ecosystems, and varied cultures of NPCs that have made the game such a hit among its devoted following.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/841ccddc94e3069c8c9495b823ee8d85cf8d0dd4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Wage war by land, air, and sea[/h2]

Myth of Empires V1.0 includes not only a large number of land-based vehicles of war such as siege wagons, ballistas, and catapults, it also adds gliders, giant sky lanterns, warships, and more. This opens up whole new domains to conquer and adds a wealth of new options to your burgeoning empire’s arsenal, but also makes combat more complex and challenging.

Myth of Empires’ unique system of administrative regions such as counties and commanderies gives the game an epic feel. Through cross-server battles and large-scale battlefields like County Battles, Prefecture Battles, and Fortress Battles, players expand their territory, hoping to etch their empire’s name in the annals of history. In the future, new Season Servers will be launched to provide an even richer variety and wealth of battlefields to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/977e2ec428d765f9fc667d64f6961f5b22d22186.jpg[/img]

[h2]Build your empire from the ground up[/h2]

Myth of Empires features a variety of structures made of wood, clay, stone, and metal. These include more than ten types of structures that can be transformed to meet your design needs, such as foundations, walls, doors, windows, railings, pillars, roofs, and more. There are also different decorative items such as skins, lighting, and furniture to make you feel at home. Whether you want to build a modest farmhouse, a rustic town, or even a massive imperial city-state, Myth of Empires makes it possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/b73d70be4ec99513017bfeeb6c6d16dee4c4a9e4.jpg[/img]

[h2]1,300+ crafting recipes, with plenty of new additions[/h2]

Myth of Empires has a wealth of crafting recipes, covering everything from structures, tools, work benches, equipment, and weapons, to taming implements and culinary instruments. V1.0 features new animal-powered, semi-automated production and warfare equipment. These new tools will further enhance your productivity and play a critical role in warfare. Use the animal-powered raft to travel rivers, sail warships to siege your enemies from the sea, soar through the air on giant sky lanterns, and wreak havoc with new ballistas. Additional new recipes will be coming in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/dfc21c7aa29024eeab01e5ed8ba64e101557562b.jpg[/img]

[h2]A menagerie of tameable beasts[/h2]

Taming has always been one of the key features of Myth of Empires. In V1.0, animals now have new attributes that can be inherited and strengthened through breeding. In addition, Beast Lords can also be tamed to enhance your abilities in combat. Nearly all of the creatures in the world of Myth of Empires can be tamed to fight alongside you in battle, for transport, or to help you with resource collection and production.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/44563b60f7248c5b2bf0e13d849dc7d33b84bfd0.jpg[/img]

[h2]More PVE gameplay[/h2]

V1.0 enriches the game’s PVE content with classic musical instruments including the pan flute, guqin, and more, as well as servants who can dance for you. There are also plenty of new decorative items to adorn your palaces with. You can also simulate massive battles with new PVE siege training and bandit raids, or engage in sportsmanlike horse races with your friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/a3d9c14c3db34fd42cf4c0c148dddf7f6cd2d9f5.jpg[/img]

[h2]New personal server modes and regional servers[/h2]

In addition to official servers, Myth of Empires V1.0 also includes five personal server modes. These include solo mode, LAN, and online servers, featuring single servers and even server clusters. Players will be able to enjoy the game however they want. In addition to the Asian, North American, and European servers available in the Early Access version of the game, we are also adding official servers in the Oceania and South America regions, bringing everyone a smooth gaming experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/adbb84cb1cbfc83218afe5bb15c6d792da5c458e.jpg[/img]

[h2]A robust mod editor[/h2]

Myth of Empires V1.0 features a mod editor. The possibilities are now endless! All modders are welcome.

[h2]Future development plans[/h2]

New civilizations are coming! The end of the trailer hints at Persian, Greek, and Egyptian civilizations coming to Myth of Empires, with all of the new structures, weapons, tools, and equipment that entails. It’s never been a better time to be a fan of Myth of Empires!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/6daad9b876b3a96f111572bf3d73fb5407d8d2b1.jpg[/img]

See you on the battlefield, Commanders!

Join our Discord: [url=discord.gg/mythofempires]discord.gg/mythofempires[/url]

notes.title: Myth of Empires V1.0 - Account Migration and New Taming Ground Structure
notes.content:
The Myth of Empires V1.0 Playtest has come to an end.

We have some new content to show you:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/e5233ee23ef3774f57fc360ea11020e35c61f8ab.jpg[/img]
[h2]Taming Ground[/h2]
At the Taming Ground, players can feed Beast Lords for a chance at boosting their Life Force and stats. There is also a chance to acquire some of the Beast Lord’s skills. The Taming Ground can be unlocked through the Guild tech tree.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/0a74780dcbcbb51946fd2d8d12b5cab16a5556c0.jpg[/img]
[h2]Royal Carriage[/h2]
A large, luxuriously-decorated horse-drawn carriage. A must have for traveling nobles and warriors of means.

In addition, we have added or optimized the following content:

1. Enhanced Breeding. Mounts that have been bred can undergo enhanced breeding to get new mount skills.
2. New Animal Skill Attributes. New skill attributes have been added increasing the ability of animals trained at animal pens to power and pull vehicles.
3. Guild Mound Farms. Divided into normal and advanced types, these farms allow players to freely plant crops. You can also use guild skills to increase the maximum yield of these farms.
4. Siege Instances. A new teleportation stele has been added to the Guild Tech tree that teleports players to instances in which they can practice siege battles. Within these instances, players can place artillery around a fortress and defend against NPC sieges.
5. New Stability Attribute. Players can forge armor to give it Stability. Stability will be deducted when repairing, but it allows the armor to be more perfectly repaired (preventing the reduction of its Durability limit). An armor’s Durability limit will be affected by repairs once it has insufficient Stability.
6. Food Boxes. Food Box recipes have been added. Large amounts of food can be placed inside these boxes, which can then be sold on the market.

The development team will continue answering frequently asked questions in future v1.0 content announcements.

Myth of Empires Version 1.0 is scheduled to release on February 21, 2024. In the meantime, we will continue to release new gameplay and content reveals. If you have any suggestions or feedback, feel free to reach out to us on official channels. Please also wishlist the game on Steam and join our official Discord server to stay up-to-date with all the latest Myth of Empires news.

[url=discord.gg/mythofempires]discord.gg/mythofempires[/url]

notes.title: Warships Take Sail in Myth of Empires V1.0!
notes.content:
With the Myth of Empires V1.0 Playtest underway, players are experiencing the Dongzhou map as well as MoE’s new gameplay for the first time. Meanwhile, the developers are hard at work on even more content, which will debut with V1.0 and subsequent updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/154dc1b40f34b46f8b447a15967e84e790f6bb83.jpg[/img]
[h2]Warship[/h2]
The Raft vehicle that we previously announced is key for traversing the waters of the Dongzhou map. However, the Raft does not have the space to accommodate all of the offensive and defensive structures required to wage war - this is where the Warship shines. More room on the deck makes this vehicle a brutally effective combat tool. It uses large animals for power, which greatly reduces the manpower cost required for travel. Proper use of this vehicle will make you an overlord of the seas. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/47747c96f3c1ce782ed049216bb414814d0d079e.jpg[/img]
[h2]Large War Wagon[/h2]
This is the largest ground vehicle in MoE to date, and also one of the most versatile. Not only can this massive tank carry multiple players or NPCs, it can also be outfitted with a variety of different tools, such as battering rams, harvesters, and mining equipment. Its flanks can also be equipped with scythes to ward off pesky would-be attackers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/5488f11862cfd0e263aa65c23074f39eec3d0250.jpg[/img]
[h2]Palanquin[/h2]
A vehicle carried by NPC humans that can be ridden by players or recruited warriors. It has no value in combat, but can make for a fun little addition to PVE gameplay.

In addition, we have added or optimized the following content:

[list]
[*] Storage Chest Trap. While this structure looks like a normal Storage Chest, it cannot actually hold any items, because it has a far more nefarious purpose: destroying this structure will unleash damage effects such as explosions, poisonous gas, and more to enemies within range.
[*] Martial Skills. Weapons can obtain new skills called Martial Skills from forging attributes. You will be able to accumulate Rage while in combat. When your Rage reaches a certain level, you will be able to use a Martial Skill.
[*] Mount Skills. You will have a chance to get active skills for mounts from Advanced Breeding. You will then be able to use these skills while on that mount.
[*] Vigilante Challenge Instances. Fight off multiple waves of NPC attacks and compete on server-wide challenge rankings. Points gained from killing NPCs can be used to purchase better weapons and equipment to use in the next wave.
[*] Racing Mode. A new racing mode and a Racing Points Shop have been added to the game.
[*] Item Reclamation. A new reclamation function has been added to Guild Warehouses. You can use this function to reclaim items that have been deleted by the system (within 7 days).
[/list]

The development team will continue answering frequently asked questions in future v1.0 content announcements.

Myth of Empires Version 1.0 is scheduled to release on February 21, 2024. In the meantime, we will continue to release new gameplay and content reveals. If you have any suggestions or feedback, feel free to reach out to us on official channels. Please also wishlist the game on Steam and join our official Discord server to stay up-to-date with all the latest Myth of Empires news.

Join our discord:
[url=discord.gg/mythofempires]discord.gg/mythofempires[/url]

notes.content:

notes.title: Myth of Empires V1.0 Upcoming Playtest and New Content!
notes.content:
Greetings, Warriors!

As previously announced, Myth of Empires V1.0 will be released on February 21, 2024. In the lead up to release, we will be holding a Steam Playtest starting on January 23 and lasting for 7 days. This test will feature 18 servers covering the Asian, European, and North American regions. When the test is live, interested players will be able to click the “Request Access” button on the Myth of Empires Steam store page to apply for the test. 

Now, we’d like to share even more content that is coming to the game at the V1.0 release:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/6255e5d283dd2ec8c02ca0c3a892710c3b0738d2.jpg[/img]
[h3]Mechanical Crate[/h3]
This is a new type of storage crate that can only store one type of item, albeit in much greater quantities than other storage crates. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/8890a88c5dec15a500e73cdeaa92d0eb27b60778.jpg[/img]
[h3]Scythe Wagon[/h3]
The scythe wagon is a combat vehicle powered by horses. It is composed of four parts: the main body, the spinning blades at the front of the vehicle, the blades at the back of the vehicle, and the blades upon the two wheels. Like a porcupine, this vehicle can shed blood in any direction it wishes. Unlike a porcupine, it is relatively quick and agile. Of course, such a vehicle is bound to see lots of action and require a little maintenance from time-to-time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/dcddf498a670a3d0d342598f2564b383e9a57667.jpg[/img]
[h3]Climbing Claws[/h3]
Central to a new mechanic making its debut in V1.0, these claws can be used to scale steep walls and cliffs. They not only give the game a certain degree of verticality, they also give players a good way to keep a watchful eye on their surroundings.

Here are answers to some of the questions we’ve seen raised in our communities recently:

[list]
[*] [b]More Details on Private Servers[/b] - In addition to the official servers, Myth of Empires V1.0 includes 5 different private server modes. Solo/Hosted Mode includes solo, LAN, and internet servers. Custom servers support both single-server and server cluster modes. Check out the table below to see more details on the differences between the different server modes. Instructions on setting up these servers will be posted at some point before the V1.0 release.
[*] [b]Reworked Horse Breeding[/b] - We have optimized various mutation stats that appear when breeding horses, making the system more balanced overall.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/adbb84cb1cbfc83218afe5bb15c6d792da5c458e.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Hand-held Illumination[/b] - We have added a variety of new handheld lanterns to the game that will help you find your way in dark areas and at night.
[*] [b]Random Equipment Stat Bonuses[/b] - Through forging, equipment can obtain random bonus attributes that will help you on your adventure
[*] [b]Equipment Signatures[/b] - You will be able to sign equipment you make. This signature will include your server info, guild, and character’s name, giving the equipment you worked so hard to craft just a little bit of a personal touch.
[*] [b]Ice Walls[/b] - In cold regions, players can pour water on their fortress walls to make them icy, which will make them more difficult for enemies to climb.
[*] New Character Appearances - Additional appearance presets have been added with different skin colors and styles.
[/list]

The development team will continue answering frequently asked questions in future v1.0 content announcements.

Myth of Empires Version 1.0 is scheduled to release on February 21, 2024. In the meantime, we will continue to release new gameplay and content reveals. If you have any suggestions or feedback, feel free to reach out to us on official channels. notes.title: Myth of Empires V1.0 New Automated Defenses!
notes.content:
Over the past couple of weeks, we’ve shown off some of the air and sea vehicles that will be available when Myth of Empires V1.0 releases in February. Today, we’d like to show off some of the new automated defenses that will be appearing in the game. These defenses are mainly powered by animals, and can assist with defending your fortress or, in some cases, with small-scale operations. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/71a371efc4c8e0b7b273ec545651ea6cf646717c.jpg[/img]
[h2]Chain Ballista[/h2]
This heavy-duty automatic ballista fires giant chain-type bolts that unfold into large, rotating umbrellas that can intercept incoming projectiles. These ballistas can be powered by pigs, wolves, leopards, or tigers placed into its power cages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/c95d8e8d0775893564b61b068805c1d35089f778.jpg[/img]
[h2]Toxic Ballista[/h2]
This relatively small ballista fires poisoned bolts. The poison on these bolts slows enemy targets and can even inflict continuous damage. These ballistas can be placed like normal defenses, or even hung upside down from ceilings or the platforms of Giant Sky Lanterns, and are powered by rabbits and foxes placed into their power cages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/647d718e0c7612b19defdefa00bdf56d0a91410f.jpg[/img]
[h2]Auto Flamethrower[/h2]
This small automated defense unleashes infernal fury upon any enemy that gets too close. Power it up by placing a rabbit or fox into its power cage.

In addition, we also have some answers for some of the community’s frequently asked questions:

[list]
[*] [b]Steam inventory items. [/b]The game’s various cosmetic items that players can purchase will be automatically converted into Steam inventory items. So long as the cosmetic item has not been used, it will be tradeable on the Steam Community Market. Cosmetic items can be used on the Classic Era servers, New Era servers, season servers, private servers, and in solo mode.
[*] [b]Crate drops.[/b] Accumulate a certain amount of time in-game to get free skin crates. Unused skins will be tradeable on the Steam Community Market.
[*] [b]Convert warriors into servants.[/b] Players will be able to convert their unused warriors into servants. This operation is irreversible. These servants will not be able to assist in combat or production and are decorative only. They can equip your clothes, weapons, and skins as well as use your interactive animations. In the initial stages, each player may have up to 30 servants, though this number may be adjusted later on depending on game performance.
[*] [b]Warriors now help collect resources.[/b] Players will be able to earn Fame with the game’s various factions (for example, Pirates) through stronghold battles. Once their Fame reaches a certain level, they will unlock that faction’s resource points. Additional Fame earned beyond that will increase the level of those resource points. Players will then be able to dispatch their warriors on quests to collect resources from those faction resource points. After some time, the warriors will return with those resources. There are currently six major factions in the game, and the resource points of each one have different difficulties and outputs.
[*] [b]New inherited animal skills.[/b] New inherited skills have been added to the animal breeding system. In addition to affecting the amount of resources collected from animal pens, these skills can affect how much power an animal generates when put into a structure’s power cage.
[*] [b] Improved boss AI. [/b]Human NPC bosses and beast lords now have improved skills and behavioral AI. This is a long-term effort which will be further improved in subsequent updates.
[/list]

The development team will continue answering frequently asked questions in future v1.0 content announcements.

Myth of Empires Version 1.0 is scheduled to release in February 2024. In the meantime, we will continue to release new gameplay and content reveals. If you have any suggestions or feedback, feel free to reach out to us on official channels. notes.title: Myth of Empires V1.0 New Aerial Vehicles and Gameplay Changes!
notes.content:
First of all, the Myth of Empires development team would like to wish everyone a Happy New Year! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/e3fb4729c8fe8b8be18ab9f841e5c8da9748d046.jpg[/img]

We recently debuted the “Raft” vehicle that will be sailing into the world of Myth of Empires in the Version 1.0 release. Today, we are going to focus on something entirely new to MoE: flight!

Let’s start with the Giant Sky Lantern. This vehicle will allow players to move through the air, and also provides some defensive and offensive capabilities. Players will be able to place small pieces of furniture and even small ballistas on the platform beneath the lantern. The Giant Sky Lantern works like a hot air balloon, with lift provided by a flame on the central platform. It can also move forward and turn with the help of a power cage. To use the Giant Sky Lantern, simply place a tamed fox or rabbit within the power cage, and make sure they are well-fed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/d52b33b432a41afd1290361a73c921e5cdd5b690.jpg[/img]

The Giant Sky Lantern, along with the recently-announced Raft, are but two of the new vehicles offered in Version 1.0 that players will have at their disposal to traverse the ever-expanding world of Myth of Empires. Later, larger upgraded vehicles will be added to meet more comprehensive construction needs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/a84a22c0380623b0be0ddfba3468fd2226195646.jpg[/img]

Next up, we have the Kite Launcher. True to its name, it is a large ballista that launches kites. These kites are different from the gliders we showed off in the Version 1.0 trailer. While gliders allow players to control their flight, these kites cannot change direction. Yet they also have their advantages. For instance, it is much easier to take flight using a kite launcher as opposed to a glider. Their flight distance can also be increased by launching them from greater heights. Kites can be equipped with a small number of items and then launched unmanned to achieve basic supply delivery objectives, or players can hang from them to move around the map more quickly. Players will also be able to launch arrows from the kite, as well as disengage from it mid-flight and descend to the ground using their own gliders, making them great for sneak attacks and reconnaissance.

Together, the Giant Sky Lantern, Kite Launcher, and hang glider mark a new era in Myth of Empires, one in which players will take to the skies to expand their dominance.

In addition, we’d also like to answer some of the questions that players have been asking us about Version 1.0.

1. [b]Server interoperability.[/b] Myth of Empires Version 1.0 will have two server groups:[u][b] Classic Era Servers and New Era Servers[/b][/u]. Classic Era Servers cover servers that already exist. The data on these will not be deleted. Servers with the new map will be added to this server group, and will be interoperable with the old servers. New Era Servers will feature all brand-new servers featuring the old map, as well as new servers featuring the new map, which will be interoperable with one another. Classic Era Servers and New Era Servers are not interoperable (see the figure below). These changes will all be implemented upon the Version 1.0 release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/5adeb0e9f5072cf7155bcc7e72e94399b26303db.jpg[/img]

2. [b]Counties and Prefectures.[/b] After the servers are adjusted, the number of counties in a single prefecture will be expanded from the original 16.
3. [b]Proficiency.[/b] Players will be able to accumulate reserve Proficiency EXP from the game lobby.
4. [b]Guild Adjustments.[/b] Guild member limits, alliance limits, and the number of counties conquerable by a single guild have all been adjusted.
5. [b]New Ways to Collect Resources.[/b] New structures similar to the “Mining Hut” will be released to cover even more types of resources.
6. [b]“PVP Areas” Within PVE Servers.[/b] Resource points in the main world have been restored, and PVP areas delineated.
7. [b]Smoother Leveling.[/b] The effects of titles and proficiencies on a player’s combat power have been optimized to make leveling progress smoother.

The development team will continue answering frequently asked questions in future v1.0 content announcements.

Myth of Empires Version 1.0 is scheduled to release in February 2024. In the meantime, we will continue to release new gameplay and content reveals. If you have any suggestions or feedback, feel free to reach out to us on official channels. notes.title: Myth of Empires Releases Version 1.0 Trailer, Reveals New Map!
notes.content:
Greetings all! We have made a brand new trailer that shows off core gameplay and the new content included in the Version 1.0 release, check it out!

[previewyoutube=2C5zMjXWoZ0;full][/previewyoutube]

Myth of Empires Version 1.0 optimizes the gameplay that players came to know and love during the game’s Early Access period. It enriches it with additional content including revamped boss AI, gliders, climbing tools, an immersive planting system, and an all-new map debuted for the first time at the end of the trailer.

Myth of Empires will be bigger, better, and more immersive than ever, and this trailer gives you a first look at all of the cool stuff we've been working on. We can't wait for you to jump into the game and see it all for themselves this February.

[h2]Key features available in Myth of Empires Version 1.0[/h2]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/b10a9e5995ff199e114d16446ee4f9f9e1e69ab4.jpg[/img]

New ways to traverse the world, include soaring gliders, climbing tools that will allow players to scale towering walls, and platform saddles that can be used for combat or simple transportation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/857e2c65fd49cacf5c358dd1a9e9c9b53f0c1ede.jpg[/img]

New defensive structures and mechanical collection tools liberate players’ creativity and enable them to build ever more advanced and powerful empires.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/bc921b013fc220d0465acd854f83e0b1796c47aa.jpg[/img]

Dongzhou Island - an expansive new world featuring islets, volcanoes, seas, and ships, as well as new boss content. This map is a free addition to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/e14f8679eb3a7873ee1e7f60d0b30b36e62ce2bb.jpg[/img]

New ways to play the game, including hosted and solo modes. In addition, private servers have been upgraded to have the same functionality as the official servers.

Modding support as well as a robust modding tool, gives players more power over the world of Myth of Empires than ever before.

Simulated sieges and challenges on the three major battlefields (County Battles, Fortress Battles, and Prefecture Battles) that will allow PvE players to experience the game’s large-scale combat against NPCs, and provide PvP players a chance to hone their strategic abilities.

New skills to make combat even more immersive and engaging.

A new planting system allows players to grow crops wherever they like, freeing them from the tether of restricted plots.

A new horse racing mode.

New characters, weapons, structure, saddle, and armor cosmetics will be released with updates after the Version 1.0 release.

notes.title: An Announcement for All Fans of Myth of Empires
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/97419650208f5ebbc669bf7638310d4982052a1b.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Myth of Empires commanders! A lot has happened in the past two years, but the development team remains resolute in its ambitions, and the playerbase is as enthusiastic as ever! Now, Myth of Empires can finally take its next step forward.

As you know, Myth of Empires is a unique massively-multiplayer online sandbox game rooted in Eastern culture and history, one into which we’ve invested sincerity and passion, and we are profoundly grateful for all the support you’ve given us since its Early Access launch in November 2021. As we reach the end of a challenging two years, we hope that you all will see our dedication to improving the game and adding new content. There is a lot of content that you haven’t seen yet - we believe you’ll be pleasantly surprised by what we have to offer in the next year!

Now let us tell you what’s coming up for Myth of Empires:

First of all, we will soon be restoring the original Steam store page for Myth of Empires, though sales will be suspended until the first quarter of 2024, when we will release v1.0 of the game. We know that your expectations for v1.0 will be high, but we are hopeful that we can meet them! This represents a fresh start for Myth of Empires! Of course, players who have purchased the Early Access version of the game will receive the 1.0 release for free. Here are some of the new features that will be included in the 1.0 release of the game:

1.Solo and Hosted modes
2.Mod support
3.A fully-featured private server mode
4.An all-new, free map
5.New skills
6.Revamped Boss AI
7.New bosses
8.New mechanical tools
9.New defenses
10.New challenges on PVE servers that simulate PVP raids
11.County Battle, Fortress Battle, and Prefecture Battle challenges on PVE servers
12.A new horse racing mode
13.A new planting system

notes.title: Myth of Empires Spring Festival events are upon us!
notes.content:
Spring Festival is only a few days away. As we say goodbye to the old year and usher in the new, Myth of Empires will be sharing special Spring Festival discounts and events with its players to commemorate the occasion. From everyone on the Myth of Empires team, Happy Year of the Rabbit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/d1b332fdd5e892693c6b22d8a524a4697cbd3587.jpg[/img]

1.New Year Money Tree Event

From January 17 at 00:00 UTC until January 31, 2023 at 00:00 UTC, players will be able to purchase Money Trees using copper at the Guild Shop (limited to 1 Money Tree per guild). Guild members will be able to obtain Blessings by completing daily quests. They can offer these Blessings at the Money Tree up to 1 time per day to randomly get Fireworks, Tang Yuan, and Lantern decorations (Spring Festival Sticks, Spring Festival Paper, and Spring Festival Twine), as well as 3 types of rare Great Spirit Pills, and farm tools.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/e5373c1418145c2b1df24bb2b739a72062ecf1cb.jpg[/img]

2.Carp Lantern Exchange Event

From January 17 at 00:00 UTC until January 31 at 00:00 UTC, players will be able to offer blessings at the Money Tree to get Carp Lantern decorations (Spring Festival Sticks, Spring Festival Paper, and Spring Festival Twine). Upon collecting these items, they can be exchanged at Neutral Camp merchants for Carp Lantern decorations, including:

1.Carp Lantern (Gold): Spring Festival Sticks *5 + Spring Festival Twine *5 + Spring Festival Paper *5 + Copper *50000
2.Carp Lantern（Blue）：Spring Festival Sticks *2 + Spring Festival Twine *2 + Spring Festival Paper *2 + Copper *10000
3.Gold Fish Lantern（Green）：Spring Festival Sticks *2 + Spring Festival Twine *2 + Spring Festival Paper *2 + Copper *10000

For more details, keep an eye on official announcements, news, and related community instructions. Once again, Happy Year of the Rabbit!

notes.title: Myth of Empires - December 2022 Server Adjustments
notes.content:
Dear Players:

It has already been a year since Myth of Empires was released into Early Access on November 18, 2021. During the Early Access period, we have received a lot of helpful feedback and suggestions from players. We would like to sincerely thank you for all of your love and support!

We are hard at work on the full release version of the game. We will continue to enrich and improve gameplay content, with the aim of making the game more immersive than ever. We will also continue optimizing and adjusting the core issues that players have raised, including those related to resource points on the main map, battlefield rules, the warrior function, game balance, and more. Improving the gameplay experience of a massively-multiplayer online game like this requires lots of polishing as well as the integration of player feedback, and that’s exactly what we plan to keep doing!

Meanwhile, in order to ensure a stable and improved gaming experience, on December 7 at 6:00AM UTC, we are planning to perform adjustments to some Myth of Empires servers. This effort will involve the addition of some new servers as well as the merging of some existing ones. Until this time, players will still be able to enter the affected servers as usual (with the exception of normal maintenance and update periods). After these server adjustments take place, the game will have 64 counties and 4 prefectures in total. Other counties and prefectures will be taken down on December 7 at 6:00AM UTC, at which time players who need to transfer servers will be compensated with in-game items.

All-Time Low Discount
From November 22 at 7:00AM UTC until November 29 at 7:00AM UTC, Myth of Empires - International Edition will be available for an all-time low price of $15.99 (originally $29.99), with 3-packs available at $43.17 (originally $89.97)!

Server Adjustment Details
Adjustment time: December 7 at 6:00AM UTC
Player migration period: November 24 at 8:00AM UTC - December 7 at 6:00AM UTC
New server addition time: November 24 at 8:00AM UTC (Exact time may change depending on the length of the required maintenance period)
Counties and prefectures affected are as follows (servers not listed will be taken down on December 7 after 6:00AM UTC):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/4542da2018c3d56aa61930121a0eb5794df69df9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/520f4a8edcb212b86a6e7c6cc33b88d79be61ca6.png[/img]

Server Adjustment Maintenance Update Patch Notes
On November 24 from 6:00AM to 8:00AM UTC, the following adjustments will be made to some server rules:

1.Crossing between prefectures no longer requires that they be linked by a Fortress.
2.Crossing between counties of the same type will no longer incur item taxes.
3.Cross-server cooldown is reduced to 10 minutes.
4.Buildings on counties to be removed can be reclaimed.
5.Resource points on PVE county maps will no longer produce resources.
6.Player carry limit will be increased by 5x.

The adjustments listed above will be reverted after server adjustments are completed on December 7.

Compensation
Recipients: Guilds with over 500 structures who will need to move servers as a result of the server adjustments will receive compensation. Guilds that do not have to migrate or that have less than 500 structures will not receive compensation. Compensation will be sent to the Lords of qualifying guilds for them to distribute.
Compensation contents and amounts are based on the number of structures a guild has. For details, please refer to the following charts:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/f8bcccb6569ecc5ff8a0a8ff9ab788c33bf7955b.png[/img]

Important Notes
1.Players whose counties are not listed in the county chart above will need to migrate servers before the migration period ends.
2.After the migration period, everything still on the original county will be lost, including structures, warriors, mounts, items listed at the Trading Post, etc.
3.Players on servers that will be migrated should reclaim their buildings as soon as possible. Most structures can be reclaimed for free by approaching them and holding E, whereupon they may be transferred across servers for free.
4.During the migration period, the free reclaim function will be kept available on structures, and structure Proficiency will stop increasing.
5.Before reclaiming a structure for free, please make sure to remove and migrate any attached heroes, mounts, or animals. If you reclaim the structure without removing them first, they will be killed.
6.Please remove any items listed at Trading Posts and migrate them as soon as possible. When the migration period ends, any items listed at Trading Posts will be permanently lost.

The above adjustments are being made in order to centralize server resources, improve operational efficiency, and to provide players with a better interactive experience. We apologize for any inconvenience caused, and at the same time, thank you again for your love and support!

notes.title: Myth of Empires Season 3 will open on Sep 28th New settings announced
notes.content:
Greetings generals and warriors! Season 3 will start on Sep 28th 16:00 UTC. The duration for Season 3 shall be 2 months. We have added some new gameplay features as well as some changes to the multipliers. Let’s go find out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/6aee7554d95d8e58c3924dd91491b7f4872dcb8a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/83079f7dd841d3e4d11adf9f47d76a645a294ef3.png[/img]


Similar to Season 2, in S3, resource collection speed, character growth, and skill growth will gradually increase when you are reaching the end of the season. Learning skills will no longer require skill books. Turrets' decay speed and repair speed have changed too. Level caps, cross-server rules, and boundary marker protection ranges remain the same. Each player will have an initial renown point are 200K.

Here are some important tips on Season 3

1. When a character died on the battlefield, only items in the inventory will drop in the loot bag. Any items in the hot bar will not drop. (Items in the hot bars will lose 10% endurance upon each death, if the item has less than 10% endurance, it will disappear)
2. Battering ram has 500% damage, endurance reduction decreased to 0.2
3. Every ranged siege weapon will be locked until week 5.
4. Shield duration against turrets is greatly increased
5. You can only bring 1 warrior to County battles, prefecture battles, and fortress battles. Week 5 will unlock all 3 warrior slots in these battles.
6. Basic HP for horses are tripled
7. New metal walls will be introduced in S3
8. Every Prefecture will have 8 counties, and Asia servers will have one more prefecture compared to S2.
9. Damage reductions for watch towers will be lowered. Watch towers will no longer have 100% accuracy. You can evade the attacks by moving. Repair speed and crafting speed for watch towers are greatly reduced. 100% hit rate will be restored on week 5.
10. Fortress battles are held every two weeks, and prefecture battles are held once a week.
11.No building restrictions at the underwater cave, you can not build buildings that have defense strength higher than 84 in some areas.
12. Boundary markers must be built on flatter grounds, it will be harder to place them on cliffs.
13. Rhinos and elephants now have a normal HP multiplier.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Myth of Empires S3 season preview, the pace of battle will be further enhanced
notes.content:
With the various forces staged in turn, Myth of Empires global season 2 is nearing its end, after the official closing on the Sep 25th, followed by the S3 season, and what adjustments will be made, and what will be the main melody of the season? Let's find out together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/d1f1e4ea232761779bcbdeb77783f23942da9c9c.jpg[/img]

[b]S3 season opening time and season cycle[/b]
On the 25th of this month, after the official end of the S2 season, after a period of preparation, the S3 season is scheduled to officially open on the 29th of this month, different from the S2 season, according to the enthusiastic feedback and suggestions of players, the S3 season cycle will be adjusted to 2 months, that is, from September 29 to November 29.

[b]More coherent, more compact in PVP[/b]
PVP cold weapon combat experience will be more consistent and compact, in S1, S2 battle process players need to find the equipment dropped after death, from a certain degree reduces the continuity of the battle. So S3 will be adjusted to the player after death equipment does not drop, of course, only worn and quick bar weapon equipment remains, the player backpack items will still drop normally.

In addition to this, large battlefields including County Battle, Fortress battle, Prefecture Battle and others open cycle is shortened, battlefield combat will be more frequent.

[b]Emphasis on short-range combat, weakening long-range consumption[/b]
The situation where both sides consume a lot of long-range siege equipment will be improved. S3 will weaken the destructive power of long-range siege equipment, including ballistas, and also make corresponding adjustments to the defending ability of the watchtowers, which is no longer a sure hit, that is, you can dodge the attack by walking, in addition, the endurance consumption of the shield from defending the watchtower is reduced, which means the shield can resist more attacks from watchtowers.

At the same time, the S3 will be a substantial strengthening of the siege damage to the battering ram, as well as reducing its durability consumption, the use of equipment such as the battering ram may become the mainstream of siege gameplay.

In addition, the horse's survivability has been enhanced to further strengthen the cavalry's combat power.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/dd1f1d40e7322a3bcb1fcb38e542868518ba00bd.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/ed983aeb42ee14f1a87acd9d51c2df7421e6c4d8.jpg[/img]

[b]New giant metal fort walls[/b]
The S3 season will also see the addition of new, stronger metal walls to further provide an advantage to the defending side.

The new metal spiked outer fort wall will also be introduced. The metal barbs on these walls will prevent enemies from climbing up to the top of the walls, which will largely counter the risk of enemy infiltration and strengthen the defensive capabilities of the outer defenses.

Some S3 settings to know first
1. The boundary marker protection range will follow the S2 mechanism. 
2. Battle skill proficiency will increase with character level.
3. The first 7 days will be the protection period, and the damage to buildings will be reduced by 90%.
4. No skill book is required to learn skills related to proficiency level.
5. All players will get 200,000 initial honor points.

About the final specific settings of the S3 season and the new content, please stay tuned with us in the later official announcement. We will see you at Season 3 of Myth of Empires!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/9ee81609dac0293199e067c9f92f621237c3405f.png[/img]

This new outfit blind box includes Destined heroes Sun Ce, Taishi Ci, and Zhang Liao. Sun Ce's skin will be red quality and the other two are orange quality. You can purchase the blind box in the Myth of Empires official store. 

[b]Zhoangyuan Festival event[/b]
Zhoangyuan festival is also known as the ghost festival in china and other Asian countries. According to Taoism and Buddhism stories, on the fifteenth day of the seventh month in the lunar calendar, the realms of heaven and hell and the realm of the living are open. People would perform rituals to transmute and absolve the suffering of the deceased. To celebrate this traditional festival, Myth of Empires will hold a limited time even on Aug 12nd.

notes.title: FAQs about Myth of Empires Season 2
notes.content:
Hello, everyone. We have sorted through and answered some of the most frequently asked questions about Myth of Empires Season 2. You will find these answers below. Thank you for supporting Myth of Empires!

I. How can I claim rewards from Season 1?
1. The rewards for reaching 100,000 points in the season can be claimed now. Press ”i” to open the Season interface, then click the reward to claim it.
2. The Season 1 Guild Points Ranking Top 10 reward can be claimed once Season 2 starts.
3. After Season 1 ends, players will get season points that they can exchange for rewards on Season 2 servers. Pop into the game once Season 2 starts to see which specific rewards you can get! In addition to season points, you’ll also get season contribution, which you can use in Guild Shops on official servers to get rewards, as well.

Important: Players using the Steam client version of the game will need to bind an International Edition account, otherwise they will not be able to claim rewards.

1. Character EXP acquisition rate is lower on Season Servers than normal servers in Season Two. Won’t leveling up take longer?
As many players have noticed, leveling up in Myth of Empires is related to collection, crafting, etc. As a result, when collection rate is increased and crafting time is reduced, your character will actually accumulate EXP much more quickly. You’ll see what we mean when you play during Season 2.

2. Is there any change to the amount of Copper Coins from Boundary Markers?
In Season 2, the amount of Copper Coins from Boundary Markers is the same on Season Servers as it is on normal servers, but NPCs will drop Copper Coins at an increased rate. Currently, the Copper Coin drop rate multiplier is 10, which will be increased as the season progresses. Additionally, the Copper Coins required for learning skills will be reduced to 10% that of normal servers.

3. Are underwater tunnels still banned?
Don’t worry. Underwater tunnels are still banned in Season 2.

4. Guild and Player limit for alliances
An alliance can now consist up to 3 guilds, while the member limit is capped at 50.

5. Elephant and rhino buffs in Season 2
The HP and damage of elephants and rhinos in Season 2 have been greatly increased. We may tweak this more throughout the season depending on results and player feedback.

6. Will beast mounts be updated in Season 2?
According to our current update plan, beast mounts will be updated during Season 2. These mounts will be available on both Season Servers and normal servers. Stay tuned for an official announcement for more details.

7. Will there be events where we can get Renown in Season 2?
Every player who participates in Season 2 will get an initial Renown of 200,000. You also won’t need to worry about low Renown affecting your Nobility. As far as specific events go, stay tuned to official announcements throughout the season.

8. Will Combat Proficiency be changed in Season 2?
As mentioned in previous announcements, your character’s Combat Proficiency will increase as they level up. When your character reaches Lv. 60, your Combat Proficiency will be Lv. 900. There is no specific multiplier per se, however.

Feel free to ask any questions you might have about Season 2 or specific multipliers and settings on official Myth of Empires channels. Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Season 2 New Content and Adjustments
notes.content:
Myth of Empires - Season 2 New Content and Adjustments

Myth of Empires’ first season will end on June 20 at 16:00 UTC, and season servers will be shut down 24 hours later on June 21 at 16:00 UTC. 
Season Two will begin shortly after the end of Season One. Season Two will feature gameplay adjustments that we made based on the feedback and suggestions we received from players during the first season. Of special note are the proficiency issues that players expressed their concern about, as well as the balance issues between offensive and defensive factions.
At the same time, we will also be adding beast mounts and dungeon challenges during Season Two. These changes will be made on both official, normal servers as well as the Season Servers.



I.Season Two Content Preview

1.Character proficiency level adjustments
We will be making major adjustments to character proficiencies. For instance, every time a character levels up, their proficiency level will increase 15 levels. 

2.Proficiency skills can be learned directly
Characters will no longer need Skill Books to learn skills related to one’s proficiency level. Instead, they can be learned directly.


3.Proficiency level progress adjustments
For the first seven days of Season Two, level and proficiency caps will be 35 and 525, respectively.
From days 8 through 15, level and proficiency caps will be 45 and 675, respectively.
From day 16 onward, level and proficiency caps will be 60 and 900, respectively. 

4.Boundary Marker protection mechanic adjustments
For Season Two, a new Boundary Marker protection mechanic will be introduced, and protection range will be increased to match the range of the decay prevention range, allowing for more flexibility in battle.
 

5. Alliance and guild limit adjustments
Each alliance now has a 50 player member limit. 

6. Initial Honor, building decay speed, and siege weapon adjustments
In Season Two, all players will start with 200,000 Honor. The decay speed of some buildings will be adjusted to 2%-4% per hour. The hit rate of Heavy Ballistas and Simple Ballistas when NPCs are assigned to them will no longer be 100%, allowing players to dodge them. The settings of Watchtowers have not been changed. 

7.Elephants and rhinos have been buffed for Season Two. More details will be announced at a later date.

II.June and July Official Normal Server and Season Server New Content

1.All-new Siege Weapon: Celestial Cannon
The Celestial is a type of mortar whose usage dates back to the Ming Dynasty. This particular weapon fired projectiles containing pieces of iron, poison, and gunpowder. The main purpose of this weapon in the game is to destroy the enemy’s siege weapons.

2.Beast Mounts are Finally Here
The previously-announced beast mounts will be arriving in Season Two!


3.All-new NPC Challenges
In the main in-game world, there will be towns and forts guarded by NPCs. Players will be able to challenge these and work together to clear them out to get special drops. 


4.Warrior Skills
Bandits too strong? Vagrants too weak? In Season Two, warriors will be able to learn skills, so players can more fully customize their followers to their liking. 

5.Buffed Elephants and Rhinos
The effectiveness of elephants and rhinos against warriors in battle has been increased, making them into formidable weapons of war.



Keep your eyes peeled for future announcements in which we’ll talk in more detail about all of the things that Season Two will offer. As always, if there’s anything you’d like to see in the game, be sure to give us your feedback and suggestions in our official communities!

notes.title: Myth of Empires - County Announcement
notes.content:
Dear players:

Last Friday, we announced that we are going to take down some county servers. Based on everyone’s feedback and suggestions, we’ve decided to add some counties to the list and take them down all at once, so that we will not need to take any more down in the future. At the same time, we will continue to improve and optimize the season server experience as needed, and add more servers if needed. We apologize for any inconvenience players may encounter during this period and thank you for your patience and understanding, as well as your continued support of Myth of Empires.

Here is how this plan will proceed:

1. After announcing these plans, we will announce the list of counties affected and the servers to which their population may relocate. Players in counties to be taken down will need to relocate to another nearby county before the relocation deadline.

2.After the relocation period expires, all data in counties to be taken down will be deleted permanently. This will include buildings, warriors, mounts, the trading post, etc.

3.Make sure to transfer buildings in advance. Most buildings can be reclaimed for free by pressing and holding the E-key, and it will transferring them to PVE servers is free.

4.Building proficiency will stop increasing for the duration of the period in which building reclamation is free.

5.Before reclaiming a building for free, make sure to remove all warriors, mounts, and animals kept in the building. If they are not moved out before the building is reclaimed, they will die when the reclamation process is carried out.

6.You will be able to transfer items from your county to a PVE county through the Stage Station for free. You will also be able to transfer warriors and mounts to these PVE counties for free, as well.

7.Players will want to remove items they have put up for sale on the Auction House as soon as possible. When the relocation timer ends, any goods left on the Trading Post will be lost permanently.

8. Starting from next week’s update, players in counties slated to be taken down will have a 5x normal load limit and can reclaim all buildings within 10 meters at once (reclaiming building products, not materials)

Compensation plans for the affected Guilds:

notes.title: 【2022.06.1st】Update/Maintenance + Dragon Boat Festival + Double Weekend Events!
notes.content:
Dear players:

Myth of Empires will undergo a temporary maintenance on June 1 from 23:00 to 01:00 UTC the following morning (two hours). Make sure to log off before then to avoid any losses. Maintenance time may be extended as needed. Thank you for your understanding.

We are fixing issues based on player feedback and will continue to do so. Here are the changes included in this update:

New Additions:
1. Added Dragon Boat Festival Event:
a)	Available: 6/2 at 00:00 - 6/12 at 23:59 UTC
b)	Added Dragon Boat Festival daily event quests. Players Lv. 50 and above can participate and get Rice Dumpling Packs.
c)	Open Rice Dumpling Packs to get 2 random rice dumplings. Each type of dumpling has one of the following effects: collection efficiency boost, skill proficiency boost, XP acquisition boost, Max HP boost, and carrying weight boost
d)	The effects of dumplings of the same type do not stack, and they aren’t affected by your character’s medicinal skill bonuses
2. This weekend from June 3 at midnight until June 6 midnight UTC, Myth of Empires will be holding a double weekend event, all players in the official servers will have 200% gather rate and 200% proficiency.
3. Added blacklist function to chat  (the blacklist will be cleared when you exit the game, and you’ll need to add people again)
4. Added Contribution value to Season Servers. This is calculated based on the number of Season Points you get in a season. After the season ends, these can be exchanged for rewards on normal official servers.
5. Added points reward and ranking reward previews to the Season Server description interface.

Optimizations and Adjustments:
1. The end of Season 1 on the Season Servers has been moved back from 6/13 at 16:00 UTC to 6/20 at 16:00 UTC. The Season Servers will close on 6/21 at 16:00.
2. Adjusted personal score rules on Season Servers
3. Adjusted guild ranking rules on Season Servers; guild member total personal scores are now calculated
4. Optimized County War donation failure notice
5. Added spawn point safe area to Prefecture Battles
6. Items at the Fair cannot be deleted

Bug Fixes:
1. Fixed Brew Spirits quest description
2. Fixed bug preventing Nobility from upgrading even when conditions were met
3. Fixed bug where warriors with the Corpse Robber skill wouldn’t drop their inventories upon death under certain circumstances
4. Fixed bug where equipment slots would appear in Cart, Wagon, and Battering Ram interfaces
5. Fixed bug where siege weapons would deal different amounts of damage depending on whether your character was male or female
6. Fixed bug where warriors would run around aimlessly upon teleporting into instances

Additionally, on June 3 at 16:00 UTC, the boundary markers of all guilds on Season Servers will be displayed on the world map. Get ready for a massive battle!

notes.title: 【2022.04.13th】New trailer + Update and Maintenance Notice
notes.content:
Dear players:

We have released a new trailer, to celebrate the new Season Servers and show what we have been working on during the past couple of months! Check it out here:
https://youtu.be/issLgGMtlbU

Myth of Empires will undergo an update and maintenance on April 13 from 23:00 to 2:00 the following morning GMT (three hours). Make sure to log off before then to avoid any losses. Maintenance time may be extended as needed. Thank you for your understanding.

We are fixing issues based on player feedback and will continue to do so. Here are the changes included in this update:

New Additions:
1. Added Season 1 servers (PVP)
a)	Season 1 lasts from April 14 at 16:00 until June 13 at 16:00 (GMT+0).
b)	Select “S1 Season Server (PVP)” from the main menu to enter.
c)	Characters, Fairs, Guilds, etc on Season Servers are unrelated to those on normal servers.
d)	Season servers have higher collection, XP, and Proficiency rates than normal servers. These rates will also increase as the season progresses. For example, if Throwing Weapon Proficiency rate is 27x at the start of the season, by the end of the season, it could be 67x.
e)	Season server cross-server, level, and damage restrictions:
i.	From April 14 at 16:00 until April 17 at 16:00 (GMT+0), cross-server functionality will be disabled; max level: 45; max Proficiency: 750; structure damage rate: -90%
ii.	From April 17 at 16:00 until April 21 at 16:00 (GMT+0), cross-server functionality will be disabled; max level: 45; max Proficiency: 750; structure damage rate reduction will be removed
iii.	From April 21 at 16:00 until April 29 at 16:00 (GMT+0), cross-server functionality within commanderies will be restored, while cross-server functionality between commanderies will remain disabled; max level: 60; max Proficiency: 900
iv.	From April 29 at 16:00 until June 13 at 16:00 (GMT+0), cross-server functionality restrictions will be removed
f)	Season server exclusive events (lasting from April 17 at 16:00 until June 13 at 16:00):
i.	Evergreen Tree: Purchase an Evergreen Tree from the Guild Store, then Lv. 40 and above players can interact with it to get 3 Prayer Chests (open Prayer Chests for a chance to get: Arts, Skill Books, Honor, Structure Wood Sutras, or Proficiency XP Books)
ii.	Sky Lanterns: Sky Lanterns will slowly descend near 6 neutral NPC camps at night in the game (Sky Lanterns have a chance to contain: Arts, Skill Books, Honor, Structure Wood Sutras, or Proficiency XP Books)
g)	Lv. 40 and above characters will have a 6-hour deletion cooldown on their account. Characters below Lv. 39 will not be subject to a deletion cooldown.
h)	Two underwater caves on the season servers have construction restrictions. It will not be possible to place buildings in the underwater caves.
i)	A Points Shop tab has been added to the Guild Shop. The points earned during the current season can be exchanged for items  in the next season (future versions of the game will add a Season Merit Shop at which players will be able to purchase items for use on normal servers.)
2. Added new medicine recipes that can be unlocked by spending the corresponding Sutra Fragments. These Sutra Fragments can be purchased from the Shop.
3. Added new furniture recipes that can be unlocked by spending the corresponding number of furniture parts. These parts can be purchased from the Guild Shop.
4. Added new Mono-shaft Chariot recipe that can be unlocked by spending the corresponding number of Mono-shaft Chariot parts. These parts can be obtained by killing Lv. 46-60 NPCs.
5. Added new Siege talent Driving Talent. After learning this skill, characters can use polearms while on Mono-shaft Chariots.
6. Added the following new items to the Guild Shop: Precious Inducer, Decorative Parts, Five Beast Sutra Fragments, Golden Chamber Sutra Fragments, Fever Sutra Fragments, Divination Sutra Fragments, Invisibility Sutra Fragments, and Internal Sutra Fragments.
7. Added guild tech quick upgrade and text description. Click and hold the icon to quickly upgrade guild tech.
8. Added log to the Guild Bank. This log will record Copper deposited, withdrawn, and spent. The Depot will no longer show Copper deposits and withdrawals.
9. Added command ordering warriors to get on and off vehicles.
10. Added game tips to the loading interface.
11. Added second confirmation window when dismissing warriors.
12. Added Execution Skill function. After knocking down an enemy unit, press E to use the execution skill of the corresponding weapon to kill it.
13. Added skin preview function. You can use skins bought from the store to customize appearances. How to use skins:
a)	Character skins: Right-click the skin from the character equipment skin interface to use it.
b)	Structure skins: Places the structure in your shortcut bar then right-click it to use the skin.
c)	Execution Skills: Equip these in the skin preview interface to view them.

Optimizations and Adjustments:
1. Removed Township Marquee to Grand Prince requirement from nobility system.
2. Adjusted structure placement distance; max distance is now 30 meters.
3. Adjusted wooden bed and bedroll placement distance; max distance is now 2 meters.
4. Adjusted drill ground’s polearm attack animation.
5. Adjusted some function icons when operating a drill ground.
6. Optimized drill ground food slot number display.
7. Items and equipment carried by warriors and horses will now drop when the warrior or horse is placed in a Guild Depot.
8. Optimized War Drum sound effects.
9. Adjusted the upgrade cooldown of Boundary Markers at some levels: Lvs. 1-2 - 1.5 hours; Lvs. 2-3 -1.5 hours; Lvs. 3-4 - 4 hours.
10. Adjusted county taxation and coinage. Tax officials now directly issue Copper Coins. Gold Bars, Turtle Coins, and Copper made at the Mint Bench will no longer be used after the update, and Mint Benches in counties have been removed.
11. Optimized some side quest rewards.
12. A weapon that has been polished past Lv. 60 will no longer receive additional skill penalties.
13. The cooldowns for rejoining or creating a new alliance after disbanding or leaving a previous one have been increased to 24 hours.
14. Adjusted County Battle rules. Now, the war declaration process will be carried out normally, whether or not a Magistrate exists.
15. Increases the rate and damage reduction of deflections for light armor.
16. Adjusted the forbidden construction range of Boundary Markers, Boulder Defensive Walls, and Boulder Gates. Boundary Markers can no longer be overlapped with Boulder Defensive Walls and Boulder Gates.
17. Added Guild Level requirement tip to some buildings that have Guild Level requirements.
18. There is now a 10-second invincibility buff when respawning near a Lv. 5 or higher Boundary Marker belonging to your guild.
19. Adjusted the position of emote settings. They have been moved from the ESC menu to the skin preview interface.
20. Optimized the guild function’s Internal Affairs button.

Bug Fixes:
1. Fixed bug in which Barley Seed yield would not be affected by skill bonuses.
2. Fixed bug that prevented the On the Prowl art from taking effect normally.
3. Fixed some abnormal scenes.
4. Fixed bug that would allow placing structures in strongholds to affect NPC respawns.
5. Fixed bug that prevented Intermediate and Advanced Lumber Yards from producing rare wood.
6. Fixed bug that caused iron collection tools to deal less damage after being polished.
7. Fixed bug allowing structures to be placed in Skirmish Battles.
8. Fixed damage bug with the Kung Fu Expert skill.
9. Fixed bug that would cause number of recruitable warriors to display incorrectly when recruiting a warrior after server maintenance.
10. Fixed character creation interface display bug.
11. Fixed bug that would cause watchtowers to automatically counter attack allied units.
12. Fixed bug allowing warriors in combat to exceed limit.
13. Fixed bug causing abnormal payments at Guild Stage Stations.
14. Fixed territory interface server search error.
15. Fixed Fine Field repair material bug.
16. Fixed bug that would cause death when idling in caves.
17. Fixed war elephant/rhino armor recipe description error.
18. Fixed bug allowing players to remove horse armor from other players’ horses in Skirmish Battles.
19. Fixed Flaming Piercing Bolt description error.
20. Fixed bug that would allow warriors to mount vehicles while seriously wounded.
21. Fixed bug where excess Guild XP would prevent leveling up normally.
22. Fixed Flamethrower unit collision bug.

Custom Servers:
1. Fixed bug where servers sometimes could not be selected from the custom server list.


If you encounter any problems while downloading, installing, or entering the game, please contact customer service: https://bit.ly/3fGEldA


Thank you again for your support!

1 Money Tree
Time: Jan.22nd 16:00 – Feb.15th 16:00
Content:
I.	Money Tree is for sale in Guild Shop at 50,000 copper coins each. 
Guild members who are above Lv.3 can buy Money Tree at Guild Shop at 50,000 copper coins. Each Guild can only place one Money Tree.
II.	The players can get one Blessing Coin when completing five daily quests per day. Blessing Coins is not droppable or movable. 
III.	Guild members whose levels are above Lv.40 can spend one Blessing Coin on the Money Tree to be blessed with New Year Gift to unlock rich items.
IV.	Members of one Guild can pray for a blessing from the Money Tree 100 times in total. Money Tree will disappear 24 hours later after being placed.

Time: Jan.22nd 16:00 – Feb.15th 16:00
Content: 
When guild shop level reaches Lv.4 in guild tech, Mount Spirit Pill will be shown in the guild shop during the event. Guild members who reached Lv.45 can buy Mount Spirit Pill in the guild shop. One member can buy at most one pill per day.
3. Let there be fish
Time: Jan.22nd 16:00 – Feb.15th 16:00
Content:
The player has a chance to fish carp anywhere by the river. When the player reaches Lv.40, they can use one carp to get refined fish oil five times per day.

Time: Jan.30th 16:00 – Feb.15th 16:00
Content:
The player can pick up Sky Lantern dropped randomly from the sky and open its inventory to get Spring Festival Decorations and other festive items.

Spring Festival is a time when people get together with their families to enjoy delicious food and celebrate the new year together. To prevent building from decay when our players celebrate the Chinese New Year with their families, we will start boundary marker's prevention from Jan. 24th 0:00 to Feb. 14th 0:00, where all player's buildings within the range of their boundary marker won't decay even if they didn't donate on time.

notes.title: Update on Myth of Empires and Steam
notes.content:
Dear Player,

Angela Game has filed a lawsuit (Click the link for details www.dropbox.com/s/hc6hpw8gdm3f4au ) alleging that Studio Wildcard and Snail Games USA made knowingly false statements to Steam to induce Steam to delist Myth of Empires.
 
We are seeking a preliminary injunction to have Myth of Empires restored to the Steam store as soon as possible.  The case is scheduled for hearing on January 31, 2022.
 
We are continuing to develop and update Myth of Empires. The current servers for the Steam version of the game will continue to operate as normal. We will also continue our work opening new servers as well as developing new events. In addition, we can tell you that we’re actively working on bringing the game online, both on our official website and our game platforms. Players can continue to experience the world of Myth of Empires with their friends. Thank you for all your support.
 
We will continue our work on Myth of Empires as well as our future projects.
 
Thank you again for your faith and support!
 
-Angela Game and the Myth of Empires Team

notes.title: Myth of Empires - New Year Event Started on Dec. 23rd
notes.content:
Dear Player,
 
We are excited to announce that the New Year Event has already launched on December 23rd. As the first holiday-themed event in the early access version, we introduced four events featured by unique content, exciting gameplay, and new experiences. New Year Event will run until January 3rd. You don’t want to miss the festive atmosphere in Myth of Empires, so stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/488381b612f17aa288db57f65c1755cebf62dd74.jpg[/img]

I. New Year Treasure Hunting
From December 23rd to January 3rd, you will run into high-tier warriors lurking around the world map whose mission is to guard the new year’s treasure chest. Defeat them and open the treasure chest, and you’ll have the chance to get valuable treasures below: 
1. New Year Exclusive Interior Decoration: Lantern, Endless Knot, and Firecrackers.
2. Fireworks: Bloom & Prosper, Outshine Flowers, Hundred Flowers, Purple & Red, and Jumping Jacks. You can use a torch to ignite them.
3. Guild Rubbing Scrolls: Rubbing scroll includes “Lantern,” “Vital Tiger,” “Auspicious Cloud,” and “Magpie.” You can use the rubbing scrolls on the banner.
4. Turtle Coin of White Metal: You can use this officially minted turtle-shaped coin to trade more than a hundred copper coins. 
5. Jiaozi (Chinese dumpling): Imagine the taste of a light dough wrapping around meats& vegetables. Jiaozi, the true mouth-watering euphoria… You can eat Jiaozi to restore Fullness and recover from Toxicity. 
6. New Lv.10 and Lv.30 Weapons

II. New Year Outfit
Complete the daily quest to get the fragments of New Year Outfit. You can unlock the outfit after collecting 30 fragments. After that, you can toggle outfit mode in the equipment panel and right-click to unlock the corresponding outfit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/313c73173499a3632e2e916c4022e9937d183ee5.jpg[/img]

III. Snowball Fighting
Complete the daily quest to get the snowball. You can throw it to your friends and provide them with a buff for 20 seconds, during which their HP, Max Stamina, and related regeneration rate will be increased.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/fac3bed2441d48a63682ce6a1d8df054d6277371.jpg[/img]

IV. Sky Lantern
On December 23rd at 16:00 UTC, you are going to see a swarm of gently floating sky lanterns carrying treasure chests in the night sky. Different treasures will drop down randomly, including:
1. Big and Small Red Packet. Open the red packet, and you have a chance to get Turtle Coin of White Metal, Quenching Essence, and Black Stone.
2. New Year Exclusive Interior Decoration: Lantern, Endless Knot, and Firecrackers.
3. Fireworks: Bloom & Prosper, Outshine Flowers, Hundred Flowers, Purple & Red, Jumping Jacks. You can use a torch to ignite them.
4. Jiaozi.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/06353881a6d90255e47fd0ecb32d396c82259cb4.jpg[/img]

In the meantime, you will also have a chance to get Cloud-piercing Arrow by defeating high-tier warriors on the world map. You can shoot the cloud-piercing arrow into the sky and summon a sky lantern randomly.

Lastly, we are further optimizing the performance of War Elephant Tank and War Rhino Tank in the game, and they will be introduced shortly after.

There are more surprises and gifts awaiting you! Come and celebrate the new year together with your friends in Myth of Empires. 

The Myth of Empires Team

notes.title: ACE abnormal problem solution
notes.content:
We upgraded our security components after our latest update on Dec. 17 UTC. When the game starts, if the security component runs abnormally, the following window will pop up and exit the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/6e3accd63820e0fcae3da8076a6b390a8784c21d.png[/img] 
Normally, you just need to follow the steps below to check and deal with it to return to normal

1.	When the game is running under non-administrator rights, the UAC window will pop up when the game is running, you need to click Allow, otherwise the security system will not operate normally.

2.	Check if the ACE service is disabled
Press “[u][i]Win + R[/i][/u]”, enter “[u][i]services.msc[/i][/u]” in the Run window and press OK button.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/d96fa21279592bfb9b89e701b231e2c5d3f3e76f.png[/img]
Find the service named [u][i]Anticheat Expert Service[/i][/u] and check if it is disabled
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/d2061b04addb2213174a20b2449c68ff17f46323.png[/img]
If “[u][i]Disabled[/i][/u]”, change to “[u][i]manual[/i][/u]”
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/8660b3d4f5a97b85f4a72323a3d6ac1532ba4fa8.png[/img]
Press OK button.
3.	Check if the security component is disabled.
Check whether the security process is disabled by anti-virus software(such as McAfee), confirm whether [u][i]SGuard64.exe, SGuard32.exe, SGuardUpdate64.exe, SGuardUpdate32.exe, SGuardSvc64.exe, SGuardSvc32.exe[/i][/u] are blocked from running.
At the same time, confirm whether the above process network is also disabled
4.	Check if the ProgramFiles environment variable is correct
Press [u][i]Win+R[/i][/u], enter [u][i]%programfiles%[/i][/u], and confirm to see if the folder can be opened. If it says "File not found", follow the steps below to set:
a.	Right-click My Computer/Computer, and click Properties—Advanced System Settings—Environment Variables;
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/2ad08213a1df99d2c48f25b3733933ce2c9b0414.png[/img]
b.	Click the "New" button below, and enter [u][i]programfiles[/i][/u] in the variable name box and [u][i]C:\Program Files[/i][/u] in the variable value, then press ok
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/80666234a0b1c7cf7d91f345bb7b8219c4413438.png[/img]
c.	Restart the computer
5.	If none of the above steps can be resolved, please delete the [u][i]C:\Program Files\AntiCheatExpert[/i][/u] folder and restart the game

If you encountered a popup window prompting you that security components are abnormal, and you tried the solutions but didn't work, you can give us your feedback in our official communities. 

Thank you for your surpport.

notes.title: Myth of Empires Updates Coming December
notes.content:
Dear Player: 

After the update featured by War Elephant/Rhino Armor on December 11th, we received cheers and applause from many players around the world. With many exciting updates on the way, we are dedicated to bringing you fresh content and a better experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/d05b58866a1a672e78507ae62d709af6998ed4e8.jpg[/img]

The free and flexible combination of weapons can benefit your transportation, breakthrough, and siege power. 
 
We’re more than excited to announce that the New Year Event for Myth of Empires is coming. As the first holiday-themed event since the release of the Early Access version, here’s what you can expect: Events like “New Year Treasure Hunting,” “Snowball Fighting,” “Sky Lantern,” Items likes New Year Outfit and Fireworks. notes.title: Regarding Recent Events
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Regarding the recent delisting of Myth of Empires on Steam as well as subsequent developments:

A few days ago, Steam received allegations of suspected copyright infringement concerning Myth of Empires, and in accordance with the DMCA and to exempt itself from liability, has temporarily removed Myth of Empires from its store. Our development team solemnly declares: Angela Game fully owns all rights and property associated with Myth of Empires and will actively respond to any doubts or allegations on this point. We are in active contact with Steam and are doing our best to restore the game to their store. We apologize for the inconvenience this has caused players. 

At the same time, we will continue to improve the overall optimization of Myth of Empires as well as maintain normal operations and development work. We are currently preparing a large number of content updates that cannot be brought online due to the current special circumstances, but players that have purchased Myth of Empires can rest assured that we are confident we will bring you a better gaming experience.

Thank you for your support and understanding.


- Angela Game and The Myth of Empires Team
