notes.title: Fair Play Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/102d612db5c8881d667d1ea3a13c5d5fddbbee5b.jpg[/img]

In order to maintain a fair game environment and bring you a better game experience, we hope that you read the following carefully.

[b]Behaviors that can result in permanent bans:[/b]
1. Any modification or debugging of the game client, including but not limited to: decompiling the program, packet deception, hacking the game client, etc.
2. Use of any unapproved third-party software that may adversely affect gameplay, including but not limited to: hacks, mods, scripts, plug-ins, etc.
3. Use of DDOS attacks or any other technical means to obtain in-game benefits.
4. Direct or indirect use of game bugs, exploits, etc. in order to obtain an advantage, disrupt game balance, or for personal gain.
5. Purposefully traveling to areas of the map that are normally inaccessible (outside the boundaries of the main map or underground).
6. Using bugs to inflict losses on other players.


[b]Behaviors that can result in getting muted in-game:[/b]
1. Making remarks with the intent to impersonate official personnel, admins, or GMs.
2. Intentionally spreading false and malicious comments about the game.
3. Posting advertisements or promotions unrelated to in-game content.
4. Using offensive, hateful, and/or threatening language such as racial or sexual discrimination, harassment, abuse, endangerment of others, stalking, doxing, or any other illegal or illicit conduct.
5. Discussion or promotion of illegal methods or exploits that undermine the fairness of the game.

[b]Inappropriate character/guild names:[/b]
1. Names cannot contain vulgar, slanderous, obscene, hateful, racial, ethnic or other offensive content, including but not limited to pornography, gambling, drugs, and other sensitive topics. Once an offense has been verified, we will force you to change your name.
2. Do not impersonate game managers (GMs) or any other person officially associated with the game.

[b]Malicious reporting:[/b]
1. Intentionally reporting players who have not committed any violations may result in bans from 2 hours up to 24 hours, depending on the circumstances. Repeat offenders may be banned for longer periods of time, or even permanently.

[b]For PVE servers:[/b]	
1. It is forbidden to maliciously block off multiple resource points on the map at the same time.
2. It is forbidden to maliciously hinder others from a normal game experience, behaviors including but not limited to: blocking off areas of the map, preventing players from expanding their bases, building around players or their NPCs/animals so as to block them in and restrict their movement, etc.
3. It is forbidden to block off default respawn points and dungeon entrances.
4. We have the right to directly demolish any buildings that violate these rules and ban repeat offenders.

Myth of Empires is still an evolving game, so we have the final right to interpret all current rules as we see fit and will update the rules as needed. We would ask you to keep these rules in mind and pay attention to further updates to them, so as not to affect your game experience or the game experience of others by violating them. 

Thank you for your support!

The Myth of Empires Team

notes.title: Guide of Building Ownership for Guild Members
notes.content:
Dear MOE Players,

Recently we got some feedback that some players lost their buildings’ ownership after they quit the Guild. We’re sorry for any misunderstanding about this issue. 

Guild Leader has three options to choose from when setting building ownership of guild members. Here is the in-game note for your reference.

1. Guild Ownership and Guild Management: All your buildings will be owned by the Guild after joining, and you need Guild's permission to use your buildings. Guild will confiscate all your buildings once you quit.

2.  Personal Ownership and Guild Management: You still own all your buildings after joining, but you need Guild's permission to use your buildings. All your buildings will still be yours after you quit the Guild.

3. Personal Ownership and Personal Management: You still own all your buildings after joining, and nobody can use your buildings without your permission. All your buildings will still be yours after you quit the Guild.
 
When you join a guild, you will see its building ownership setting. Please choose the Guild with your favorable building ownership setting. We’ll provide more guidance and explanations to help you get a better experience. Thank you!

notes.title: Splash screen crash bug identified and fixing, here is a temporary workaround:)
notes.content:
After investigation, we have identified the cause of the splash screen crash that occurs when some players launch the game. Thank you for your patience with this!

While we are working on an official fix for this, you can create a new Windows account on your PC as a temporary workaround so that you can play the game now. Here's how:

1. Click the Start button, then Settings.
2. Click Accounts, then "Family & other users".
3. Click "Add someone else to this PC".
4. Click "I don't have this person's sign-in information".
5. Click "Add a user without a Microsoft account".
6. Set a username (a password is not necessary).
7. Log out of your current Windows account, then login to the one you just created.
8. Start the game using Steam and it should launch normally.

Again, this is a temporary workaround and is by no means intended to be a permanent fix. We hope to announce an official fix very soon. 
Thank you very much for supporting Myth of Empires, and an extra special thanks to @DeusVult  for identifying this workaround!

notes.title: Frequently reported issues and troubleshoot!
notes.content:
Dear MOE Players,

We are grateful for your support for the early access version of Myth of Empires. We are deeply disturbed by the fact that due to some unexpected bugs and glitches, some of the players have encountered issues, such as failing to sign in or forced termination of the client. 
With a goal to provide our players with the best game experience, our development team is working hard to solve all the reported problems, in the meantime, we have collected a few frequent reports and provided the troubleshoot below;

[b]1. Screen stuttering and FPS drop.[/b]
[b]Solution:[/b]
 Please quit your translation software since the screen word capturing function of this software might conflict with the hotkeys of the game.

[b]2. Abnormal FPS.[/b]
[b]Solution:[/b] 
Please close the desktop management software such as fences cause this kind of software will cause the malfunction of the game.

[b]3. Forced termination when playing the game with the Message below or without any message.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/4ef1c64ff854df8c412724e7f0094dccf987df51.png[/img]
[b]Solution: [/b]
a. Update your windows system.
b. Update your display card’s software.
c. Fix your DirectX software.
d. You may have to reinstall your system if all of the above solutions failed.

[b]4.BattleEye related issue when launching the game.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/56dc9efe0d609bae8a82c0efa4312515dfa98400.png[/img]
[b]Solution:[/b]
1. Delete the version.dll file on your computer. Otherwise, you can try to reinstall the latest version of Steam.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/465b8b48b527d07d452544f2ffb2b826698080eb.png[/img]
BattleEye will block some software and the message above can be ignored cause generally, it won’t affect the normal function of the game. Otherwise, you can try to uninstall the related software.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/06771664f156378898a92c12558c87c994595c15.png[/img]
Go to Tencent PC Manager - Tools - Computer Clinic - Software Problem.  Click Fix DLL Files. Otherwise, you can uninstall Tencent PC Manager and restart the game again. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/4ef1c64ff854df8c412724e7f0094dccf987df51.png[/img]
Solution: 
a. Update your windows system.
b. Fix your related files.
c. You may have to reinstall your system if all of the above solutions failed.

[b]5. I can’t see the server list in-game.
Solution: [/b]
Please close your VPN and restart the game again. If you didn’t open VPN then please try using the network accelerator and restarting the game. 

[b]6. I can’t start the game after setting the game image quality.[/b]
[b]Solution: [/b]
Delete the setting folder of the game client in C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\Local\Moe\Saved\Config

notes.title: Myth of Empires Global Closed Beta Announced --- Registration Goes Live!
notes.content:
Myth of Empires, a multiplayer sandbox survival game with a high degree of freedom,
will be holding a global closed beta test starting 1am October 2nd 2021, lasting until 1am October 10th, 2021(PDT time). Registration goes live today.

[b]Apply for the beta through Steam’s Playtest function here:[/b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1371580/Myth_of_Empires]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1371580/Myth_of_Empires[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/54a8537cbbe93e343808e21a73724065c6990a82.png[/img]

In this ravaged eastern world, players will fight to survive, build to last, and unite to prosper. To tame the wild horses, build fortresses, lead armies in massive battles, and siege enemy cities are only parts of the experience to establish one’s own empire.

[b]Key features available in the Beta Test:[/b]
[list][*] Brave a wild world filled with bandits, animals, and hostile players. Quench hunger with meat collected by hunting, and collect various resources from the open world to build your fort brick by brick.[/list]
[list][*] Engage enemies in intense, tactical battles. Control the direction of your strikes to maximize their impact and damage.[/list]
[list][*] Craft weapons of different sorts and armor of different tiers to prepare for the battle. Make swords, spears, halberds, axes, throwing weapons, crossbows, bows, shields, and more to fill your arsenal.[/list]
[list][*] Construct your very own customized structures piece by piece, and build siege weapons such including ballistas, catapults, trebuchets, and siege ladders to wreak havoc upon enemy fortresses.
[/list]
[list][*] Recruit NPCs through peaceful means or by force and have them collect resources, craft items, hunt, or fight alongside you. Tame horses that you can ride into battles, or breed them to make new horses with attributes more suited to your needs.[/list]
[list][*] A robust guild system that allows players to form clans with their friends. Work together to fend off enemy attacks, conquer your server, and reign supreme![/list]
[list][*] New gameplay and content: County, province, and fortress siege battles, as well as improved voice-chat, a new trade system, and character voices.[/list]
[list][*] New environments: Snowy mountains, desert, swamps, caves, and an all-new weather system.[/list]
[list][*] New craftables: New weapons, armor, buildings, recipes, crops, carts, and more.[/list]
[list][*] New animals: Elephants, rhinos, crocodiles, butterflies, fish, and more.[/list]
[list][*] PVE and PVP servers will be available in Asia, North America, and Europe.[/list]

notes.title: [Dev Log - 05] Myth of Empires - Flowers, Birds, Bugs, and Fish
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/1c1616e80e8dec21dafafea5287c9bcb32a3e213.png[/img]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vy_9O7EF0kg

A lot of the content we’ve been working on lately is aimed at making the game world feel more alive. After all, a world populated only by horses, deer, and wolves would feel rather...sparse. Here’s some of what we’ve been adding:

Flowers: We’ve been adding lots of different flowers and plants to the game to color it up a bit. Of course, they do more than just make the world look pretty; these plants can also be used as ingredients for medicine.
Birds: We are adding birds to the game. These birds can be hunted and used for food and as materials for other recipes.
Bugs: Currently, the game features locusts. We are also adding more insects, including but not limited to butterflies and beetles. Like locusts, you will be able to use these as materials for recipes.
Fish: A common request during the alpha test, fishing will be added into the game. Players will be able to fish a variety of different species. Of course, if the delicate art of fishing isn’t quite your speed, you can also simply spear them.

- Myth of Empires Dev Team

notes.title: [Dev Log - 04] Myth of Empires - Monthly Development Progress Report
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/e3f1d3e550219ee5b5658843bb7347d0682f4f36.jpg[/img]
Greetings, everyone. Here is some of the stuff we’ve been working on for the month of May. We’ll be showing some of this stuff off in the near future, so stay tuned!

[h3]1. Game World[/h3]
We have completed filling out the game world with various terrains, animals, plants, strongholds, minerals, and other resources. We are now testing and optimizing the whole map. The environmental variety of the global alpha test was relatively weak compared to what will ultimately be in the game, including mountains, canyons, snowy regions, Gobi-esque desert, swamps, and other terrain. The game will also feature more varied wildlife, including elephants, rhinos, tigers, crocodiles, fish, more insects, birds, as well as more plants and minerals.

[h3]2. Weather[/h3]
In the alpha test version of the game, there were two weather states: rain and sun. The weather will be further refined and varied, and will change depending on the environment. For example, it will snow in mountainous areas, there will be mist in swamps, and the sun will be scorching hot in the desert regions. Some weather states will adversely affect the player. Additional weather states like cloudy, overcast, thunderstorms, and sandstorms will also appear.

[h3]3. Large Scale Battles[/h3]
In the alpha test, we tested County Battles. Larger-scale Prefecture Battles and Pass Battles are being developed and will be an important part of guild gameplay. Once development of these modes is complete, they will undergo extensive testing to ensure balanced and fair gameplay.

[h3]4. Character Animations[/h3]
We have completed two rounds of motion capture work and are in the process of implementing and optimizing these animations. These include combat animations in various states, as well as harvesting, logging, and planting. We will show off some of these improved animations in the future.

[h3]5. Other Additions (not a comprehensive list):[/h3]
Players will be able to prospect and mine underground minerals
Guild management is vastly improved, allowing leaders to more effectively manage the work of the guild members
NPCs are being reworked so that players will be able to customize their appearance
We are adding more crops so that players can make more different kinds of foods, materials, and medicines
We are adding an auction house at which players can sell and trade resources
We are adding more buildings and a new type of building material
We are adding other functions and content based upon feedback received in the alpha test

The above content is part of what we’ve been working on this month. We will show you this content as well as disclose some of the other things we’ve been working on in the future. We’re working as hard as we can to improve the game and get it ready for future tests. Thank you for your support. We’ll share more with you as soon as we can!

- Myth of Empires Dev Team
